rows.output: "Ni igba ti ewu igbi omi nla ti waye ni ana, awọn eniyan si n ṣe awọn iṣẹ lori eti okun ati pe wọn ko sa lọ ni kiakia, wọn si di awọn olufaragba," Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, agbẹnusọ fun ajọ to n ṣakoso iṣẹlẹ ajalu ni Indonesia BNPB sọ ninu ipade kan ni Jakarta.
rows.reference: ''Nigbati ìdúnkoòkò tsunami náà dìde ní àná, àwọn eniyan sì ńṣe iṣẹ́ wọn létíkun tíwọn kòsì sá kuro lójú-ẹsẹ̀ tí wọ́n sì di ẹniti o farakó-áásá,'' ni Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, agbẹnusọ fún àjọ tó ńrísí díndín ewu ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àjálù kù lorilẹ-ede Indonesia BNPB sọ nínú ìfitónilétí kan Jarkata.

rows.output: "Ìjì líle náà kò wá ní ìkọ̀kọ̀, ó mú ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́, igi, ilé, ó sì kọlu ohun gbogbo tó wà lórí ilẹ̀," Nugroho sọ pé, ó sì fi kun pé ìjì líle náà ti rìn káàkiri òkun tó ṣí sílẹ̀ ní iyara 800 kph (497 mph) kí ó tó kọlu etíkun.
rows.reference: Ìkún-omi tsunami náà kòwá nípa ara rẹ̀, ó wọ́ àwọn ọkọ́ ayọ́kẹ́lẹ́, àwọn igi, àwọn ilé, ó kọlu ohun gbogbo lórí ilẹ̀,'' ni Nugroho sọ, tí ó sì fikún un pé ìkún-omi tsunami náà ti rin ìrìn-àjò kọjá gbangba òkun ní àwọn ìwọ̀n ìṣọwọ́sáré kìlómítà ẹgbẹ̀jọ̀ ní wákàtí kan (máìlí 497 ní wákàtí kan) kí ó tó kọlu bèbè òkun.

rows.output: Àwọn kan gun igi láti sá lọ kúrò ní ìjì líle, ó sọ.

rows.output: Àwọn ìkún-omi tó tẹ̀ lé e yí padà ní ìlú ẹlẹ́gbin náà lọ́jọ́ Àìkú.

rows.output: Àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ìgbóná ńlá náà wáyé ní àgbègbè kan tí ó ní ẹ̀dá 2.4 mílíọ̀nù ènìyàn.
rows.reference: Àwọn ilẹ̀ rírì oní-ṣiṣẹ̀-ń-tẹ̀lé náà ní wọ́n mọ̀lára ní agbègbe kan tóní mílíọ̀nù méjí àti irinwó eniyan.

rows.output: Àwọn ara àwọn olùkú náà ni a rí tí wọ́n wà nínú ìkòkò ilé tí ó ṣubú, ó sọ, ó sì sọ pé 540 èèyàn farapa àti 29 sì ń ṣàìsàn.

rows.output: Ìbánisọ̀rọ̀ “pàdánù pátápátá láìsí ìsọfúnni” láti Donggala, Nugroho sọ.

rows.output: Ìgbìmọ̀ ìdìbò ìpínlẹ̀ náà sọ pé kò sí ìròyìn ìwà ìbàjẹ́ ní 1 ìrọ̀lẹ́.
rows.reference: Ìgbìmọ̀ amúṣẹ́ṣe lori ìdìbò ti orilẹ-ede náà sọpé kòsí àwọn ìròyìn àìṣedéédéé kankan títí aago méjì ọ̀sán.

rows.output: Báwo ló ṣe rí lára ​​àwọn tó wà níbẹ̀, ó kéré tó 16 nínú ọgọ́rùn-ún, ní ìfiwéra pẹ̀lú 34 nínú ọgọ́rùn-ún ní ìdìbò àpéjọpọ̀ tó kẹhin ní 2016 nígbà tí 66 nínú ọgọ́rùn-ún àwọn tó wà nínú àtòkọ náà kópa nínú ìdìbò náà.
rows.reference: Bótiwùkórí, ìjáde-dìbò dúró ní ìdá mẹ́rìndínlógún ninu ìdá ọgọ́ọ̀run, bí a ṣafiwé rẹ̀ sì ìdá mẹ́rìnlélọ́gbọ̀n ti inú ìdìbò àwọn aṣojú-ṣòfin tókọjá lọ́dún 2016 nigbati ìdá mẹ́rìndínláàádọ́rin àwọn olùdìbò tó forúkọ sílẹ̀ fi ìwé àmútẹkasí láti dìbo wọn sílẹ̀.

rows.output: Mo jade lati dibo nitori awon omo mi, ibi wa ni Yuroopu," ni Gjose Tanevski, 62, oludibo ni olu-ilu, Skopje.

rows.output: An taso ne saboda shirye-shiryen canza sunan majalisar zuwa Majalisar Wales.
rows.reference: Abin ya tashi ne saboda shirye-shirye na canza sunan taron zuwa Majalisar Dokoki ta Welsh.

rows.output: AMs a ko'ina cikin fagen siyasa suna damuwa cewa zai iya jawo kunya.
rows.reference: AM a ɓangaren siyasa sun damu ƙwarai don zai iya haifar da ba’a.

rows.output: Wani dan jam'iyyar Labour ya ce, "mun damu da cewa yana da sauti iri ɗaya da Twp da Pwp."
rows.reference: Wani AM na Jam’iyyar Labour ya ce ƙungiyar ta damu "yana rauji da Twp da kuma Pwp."

rows.output: Ga masu karatu a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh, twp yana nufin daft da pwp yana nufin kaho.
rows.reference: Don masu karatu a wajen Wales: A cikin Welsh twp yana nufin hauka kuma pwp yana nufin kashi.

rows.output: Wani memba na Plaid AM ya ce kungiyar baki daya "ba ta yi farin ciki ba" kuma ta ba da shawarar wasu hanyoyi.
rows.reference: Wani Plaid AM ya ce gungun gaba ɗaya “ba su ji daɗi ba” kuma ya ba da shawarar zaɓuɓɓuka.

rows.output: Wani ɗan jam'iyyar Conservative na Welsh ya ce ƙungiyarsa tana "bude tunani" game da canjin suna, amma ya lura cewa yana da gajeren tsalle na harshe daga MWP zuwa Muppet.

rows.output: A cikin wannan mahallin harafin Welsh w ana furta shi kamar yadda ake furta harafin u na Ingilishi na Yorkshire.
rows.reference: A wannan bigiren, ana furta harafin w na Welsh ne kwatankwacin furucin Turanci na Yorshire na harafin u.

rows.output: Hukumar Majalisar, wadda a halin yanzu take aikin tsara dokoki don gabatar da canje-canjen suna, ta ce: "Shawarar karshe kan duk wani bayanin abin da ake kira 'yan majalisar za su kasance, ba shakka, alhakin 'yan majalisar da kansu ne."
rows.reference: Hukumar Majalisar, wanda a yanzu haka ke rubuta daftarin dokar don gabatar da canje-canjen sunan, ta ce:  “Hukuncin ƙarshe a kan kowaɗanne abubuwa masu bayyanarwa abin da ake kiran mambobi na Majalisar zai kasance kuwa wani batu ne don mambobin da kansu.”

rows.output: Dokar Gwamnatin Wales ta 2017 ta ba wa Majalisar Welsh ikon canza sunanta.
rows.reference: Dokar Gwamnatin Welsh ta 2017 ta ba wa majalisar Welsh iko na canza sunanta.

rows.output: A watan Yuni, Hukumar ta buga sakamakon wani taro na jama'a kan shawarwarin da ta samu goyon baya mai yawa na kiran taron a matsayin Majalisar Wales.
rows.reference: A cikin Yuni, Hukumar ta wallafa sakamako na wata tattaunawar jama’a a kan ƙudurorin wadanda suka sami babban goyon baya don kiran majalisar Majalisar Dokokin Welsh.

rows.output: A kan batun sunan AMs, Hukumar ta fi son Mambobin Majalisar Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami goyon baya mafi yawa a cikin tattaunawa ta jama'a.
rows.reference: A kan batun sunan AMs ɗin, Hukumar ta fi son Mambobin Majalisar Dokokin Welsh ko WMPs, amma zaɓin MWP ya sami mafi goyon bayan a cikin wata tattaunawar jama’a.

rows.output: AMs suna bayyana wasu zaɓuɓɓuka, amma gwagwarmayar isa ga yarjejeniya na iya zama matsala ga Shugaban Majalisa, Elin Jones, wanda ake sa ran zai gabatar da kudurin doka kan canje-canjen cikin makonni.
rows.reference: A fili AMs suna ba da shawarar wasu zaɓuɓɓuka ne, amma gwagwarmayar isa ga matsaya za ta iya zama mai wahala ga Jami’i Mai Kula, Elin Jones, wanda ake tsammanin za ta mila daftarin dokar a kan canje-canje a cikin makonni.

rows.output: Dokar gyaran kasa za ta hada da sauran gyare-gyare ga yadda majalisar ke aiki, ciki har da ka’idoji kan cire mambobin majalisar da kuma tsarin kwamitocin.
rows.reference: Dokar a kan canje-canjen za su haɗa da sauran canje-canje na yadda majalisar ke aiki, da ya haɗa da ƙa’idoji a kan ayyana rashin cancanta na AMs da kuma tsara tsari na kwamitin.

rows.output: AMs za su samu kuri'a ta karshe kan tambayar abin da za su kira lokacin da suke tattaunawa kan dokar.
rows.reference: AMs za su sami kaɗa kuri’ar karshe a kan batun abin da za a kira su da shi a yayin da suka yi mahawarar dokar.

rows.output: Macedonawa suna kada kuri'a a zaben da ya shafi canza sunan kasar
rows.reference: ‘Yan Macedonia sun tafi yin zaɓuɓɓuka a cikin zaɓen raba gardama a kan canza sunan kasar

rows.output: Masu kada kuri'a za su kada kuri'a a ranar Lahadi kan ko za su canza sunan kasar su zuwa "Jamhuriyar Masedoniya ta Arewa."
rows.reference: Masu kada kuri’a za su yi zaɓe a kan ko su canza sunan kasarsu zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Macedonia ta Arewa.”

rows.output: An kafa kuri'ar jama'a ne da nufin warware takaddamar da aka dade ana yi da kasar makwabciyar Girka, wadda ke da lardi mai suna Macedonia.
rows.reference: An saita sanannen zaɓen ne don wani ƙoƙari na warware wani rikicin da ya yi shekara da shekara tare da makwaɓciyar ƙasa ta Greece, wadda ke da lardinta da ake kira Macedonia.

rows.output: Athens ta yi imanin cewa sunan makwabtarta na arewa yana wakiltar ikirari kan ƙasar ta, kuma ta ci gaba da adawa da neman ta na shiga EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Athens ta jima tana jajircewa cewa sunan makwaɓciyarta daga arewaci yana wakiltar wani ƙorafi ne a kan yankinta kuma ta sha maimaita ƙin neman matsayin mamba a Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: Shugaban kasar Masedoniya Gjorge Ivanov, wanda ya koma bayan yin zabe kan sauya sunan kasar, ya ce zai yi watsi da zaben.
rows.reference: Shugaban Ƙasar Macedonia Gjorge Ivanov, wani mai adawa da tsarin zaɓen kai tsaye a kan canza sunan, ya ce zai yi watsi da zaɓen.

rows.output: Duk da haka, masu goyon bayan zaben sun hada da Firayim Minista Zoran Zaev, sun ce canjin sunan kawai farashin da za a biya don shiga EU da NATO.
rows.reference: Amma, masu goyon bayan zaɓen raba gardamar, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, suna mahawara cewa canza sunan wani ɗan aiki ne da dole a yi don a shiga Tarayyar Turai da Ƙungiyar Ƙawance ta NATO.

rows.output: Karan Gidan St. Martin sun yi shiru yayin da majami'u ke fama da matsala a Harlem
rows.reference: Ƙararrawar St. Martin's Sun yi Shiru Saboda Majami’u a cikin Harlem suna cikin Gwargwarmaya

rows.output: "A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai mashaya da coci a kowane lungu," in ji Mista Adams.
rows.reference: “A tarihi, tsofaffin mutanen da na yi magana da su sun ce akwai wata mashaya da wata majami’a a kowace kusurwa,” Inji Mista Adams.

rows.output: "A yau, babu."
rows.reference: “A yau kuwa, babu ko ɗaya.”

rows.output: Ya ce bacewar mashaya ta yiwuwa.
rows.reference: Ya ce ɓacewa ta mashayun abu ne na fahimta.

rows.output: "Mutane suna mu'amala da juna ta wata hanya" a yanzu, ya ce.
rows.reference: “Mutane suna shaƙatawa ta wata hanya daban” a ranakun nan, injin shi.

rows.output: "An daina ganin mashaya a matsayin dakunan taro na unguwa inda mutane ke zuwa akai-akai."
rows.reference: “Mashayu yanzu ba ɗakuna ne da ke makwaɓta ba inda mutane ke zuwa a-kai-a-kai.”

rows.output: Game da majami'u, yana damuwa cewa kudin da ake samu daga sayar da kadarori ba zai dore ba kamar yadda shugabannin ke tsammani, "kuma da wuri ko kadan za su kasance a inda suka fara."
rows.reference: A game da majami’un, ya damu cewa kuɗin da ake samu daga sayar da kadarori ba za su jima idan kamar yadda shugabanni ke tsammani ba, “kuma nan ba da jimawa ba ko daga baya za su dawo idan suka fara.”

rows.output: Cocin, in ji shi, za a iya maye gurbinsu da gine-ginen gidaje da gidajen da za a cika da irin mutanen da ba za su taimaka wa sauran masallatan da ke cikin unguwar ba.
rows.reference: Ya ƙara da cewa, za a musanya majami’u da gine-ginen gidaje tare da manyan wurarene masu cike da irin mutane waɗanda ba za su taimaka ga sauran wuraren samun mafaka na makwaɓta.

rows.output: "Yawan mutanen da ke sayen gidajen haya a cikin waɗannan gine-gine za su kasance farar fata," in ji shi, "sannan za su hanzarta rufewa gaba ɗaya na waɗannan majami'u domin ba zai yiwu ba cewa yawancin waɗannan mutanen da suka ƙaura zuwa waɗannan gidajen haya za su zama membobin waɗannan majami'u."
rows.reference: “Mafi yawan mutane da za su sayi manyan wurare a cikin waɗannan gine-ginen za su kasance farar fata ne,” inji shi, “don haka kuwa za su gaggauta ranar da za a ce waɗannan majami’u sun rufe gaba ɗaya saboda akwai yiwuwar mafi yawanci waɗannan mutane da suka motsa cikin wadannan manyan wuraren su zama mambobi na waɗannan majami’u.”

rows.output: Dukkan majami'u biyu an gina su ne da al'ummomin farare kafin Harlem ta zama babban birnin bakar fata - Majami'ar Al'umma a shekara ta 1870, St. Martin a shekara ta 1880.
rows.reference: Duka majami’un guda biyu farar fata ne suka gina su kafin Harlem ta zama alƙaryar baƙaƙen fata - Al’ummar da ke Alƙaryar a 1870, shekaru goma bayan St. Martin’s.

rows.output: An fara kafa cocin Methodist na fari a cikin shekarun 1930.
rows.reference: Asalin farar fata mahalarta ‘yan Methodist sun fita ne a cikin shekaru na 1930.

rows.output: Jama'ar bakar fata da suke ibada a kusa da su suka karbi mallakar ginin.
rows.reference: Wani taron masu ibada baƙaƙe da ke yin ibada a kusa suka mallaki ginin.

rows.output: An dauki St. Martin a karkashin jagorancin Rev. John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci yajin aikin da ya shafi shagunan da ke kan titin 125, babbar titin sayayya a Harlem, wadanda suka ki daukar ma'aikata ko kuma suka inganta bakaken fata.
rows.reference: Taron baƙaƙen fata masu ibada ne suka karɓe ragamar St. Martin’s a ƙarƙashin Rabaran John Howard Johnson, wanda ya jagoranci ‘yan kasuwa da su ƙaurace ma sayen kaya a kan layi na 125, wani babban layin yin sayayya a Harlem, wanda ya jajirce a wajen yin hayar ma’aikata ko tallafawa baƙaƙen fata.

rows.output: Wuta a shekarar 1939 ta yi mummunar barna a ginin, amma yayin da mabiya cocin Father Johnson suka fara shirin sake gina shi, sun ba da umarnin kiran kararrawa.
rows.reference: Wata gobara a cikin 1939 ta lalata ginin sosai, amma kamar yadda mabiyan Fada Johnson suka yi shirye-shirye na sake ginin, su ne suka buɗe kayan kiɗan majami’ar.

rows.output: Mai bishara Dauda Yohanna, ɗan mahaifinsa da magaji a St. Martin's, ya yi alfahari da kiran ƙararrawa "ƙananan mutane."
rows.reference: Rabaran David Johnson, dan Fada Johnson da wanda ya gaje shi a St. Martin's, a cikin alfahari ya kiran kayan kiɗan majami’ar “ƙararrawowin mutane talakawa.”

rows.output: Kwararre wanda ya buga kida a watan Yuli ya kira shi wani abu dabam: "Kasadar al'adu" da "kayan tarihi maras maye."
rows.reference: Ƙwararren da ya kaɗa ƙararrawar a watan Yuli ya kira shi da wani abu daban: “Wata ajiyayyar dukiyar al’ada” da “wani kayan tarihi da ba za a iya maida gurbinsa ba.”

rows.output: Kwararre, Tiffany Ng daga Jami'ar Michigan, ta lura cewa ita ce motar farko a duniya da ta taka leda da dan wasan baki, Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya koma babbar motar a Cocin Riverside shekaru 18 da suka gabata.
rows.reference: Kwararren, Tiffany Ng na Jami’ar Michigan, har ila yau ya lura cewa shi ne kayan kiɗa na farko a duniya da wani mawaki baƙar fata ya rera, wato Dionisio A. Lind, wanda ya motsa babban kayan kiɗan a Majami’ar Riverside shekaru 18 da suka wuce.

rows.output: Mista Merriweather ya ce cewa St. Martin's bai maye gurbinsa ba.
rows.reference: Mista Merriweather ya ce St. Martin's ɗin ba ta musanya shi ba.

rows.output: Abin da ya faru a St. Martin a cikin watanni da suka gabata ya kasance wani labari mai rikitarwa na masu zanen gine-gine da masu gini, wasu da shugabannin cocin suka kawo, wasu kuma da bishop din Anglican.
rows.reference: Abin da ya bayyana a St. Martin’s a ‘yan watanni da suka wuce ya zama wani labari mai ruɗarwa na masana zane da ‘yan kwangila, wasu da shugabannin majami’ar da ba su da ilimi suka kawo, sauran kuwa daga ikon babban limamin ‘yan Episcopal.

rows.output: Makamashi - jikin gudanarwa na cocin, wanda ya ƙunshi shugabannin da ba na addini ba - ya rubuta diocese a watan Yuli da damuwa cewa diocese "zai yi ƙoƙari ya wuce farashin" zuwa makamashi, ko da yake makamashi ba a shiga cikin daukar masu zanen gado da masu aikin gini da diocese ya aika.
rows.reference: Sai kwamitin vestry ɗin - hukumar gudanar da yankin iyakar majami’ar, da ta haɗa da shugabanni da ba su da ilimi - sun rubuta wa babban limamin a Yuli da damuwowinsu cewa yankin iyakar majami’ar “zai nemi mika kuɗaɗen da aka kashe” zuwa kwamitin vestry ɗin, duk da cewa ba a sa kwamitin vestry ɗin ba a yin hayar masu zanen da ‘yan kwangilar da yankin iyakar majami’ar suka sa ba.

rows.output: Wasu mabiya cocin sun yi korafi kan rashin gaskiya daga bangaren diocese.
rows.reference: Wasu mabiya sun yi ƙorafi game da rashin bayyana abin da aka yi ta ɓangaren yankin iyakar majami’ar.

rows.output: Chad Hammel ya gaya wa KSWB-TV a San Diego cewa ya kasance yana nutsewa tare da abokai na kusan rabin sa'a a safiyar Asabar lokacin da ya ji yaron yana kira don taimako sannan ya tashi tare da wani rukuni ya taimaka masa ya fitar da ruwa.

rows.output: Hammel ya ce da farko ya yi tunanin kawai farin ciki ne na kama lobster, amma sai ya gane cewa "ya yi kuka, 'Na kama!
rows.reference: Hammel ya ce da farko ya ɗauka wata annishuwa ce ta kama wani losbter, amma shi ke nan sai ya “gano cewa ihu yake yi, ‘An cije ni!

rows.output: Na samu kiba!

rows.output: An buɗe dukkan ƙashin ƙirjinsa," in ji Hammel ya lura da zarar ya isa ga yaron.
rows.reference: An buɗe kashin kafaɗarsa gaba ɗaya,” inji Hammel da ya gani a lokacin da isa wurin yaron.

rows.output: "Naji wa kowa da ya fita daga ruwa: 'Akwai kifi mai zafi a cikin ruwa!'" Hammel ya kara.

rows.output: An tura yaron asibitin yara na Rady a San Diego inda yake cikin mawuyacin hali.

rows.output: Jinsin kifin kifi da ke da alhakin kai hari ba a san shi ba.

rows.output: Jami'in tsaron ruwa, Kwamanda Larry Giles ya ce a wani taron manema labarai cewa an ga wani kifi a yankin makonni kadan da suka gabata, amma an gano cewa ba wani nau'in kifin da ke da hadari ba ne.
rows.reference: Kyaftin Larry Giles mai kula da rayuwa ya ce a gaban maneman labarai cewa an ga wani babban kifin teku a cikin yankin ‘yan makonni baya, amma an ƙudurta cewa ba daga wani jinsuna ne babban kifi mai haɗari ne ba.

rows.output: Giles ya kara cewa wanda aka azabtar ya samu munanan raunuka a yankin kirjinsa.

rows.output: Jami'ai sun rufe hanyar shiga bakin teku daga Ponto Beach a Casablanca zuwa Swami's a Ecinitas na tsawon sa'o'i 48 don bincike da dalilai na tsaro.

rows.output: Giles ya lura cewa akwai fiye da nau'ikan kifin kifi 135 a yankin, amma mafi yawa ba a ɗauke su a matsayin masu haɗari ba.

rows.output: Shirye-shiryen Sainsbury na shiga kasuwar kula da kyau ta Burtaniya
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s yana shirye-shiryen shiga kasuwar kwalliya ta Birtaniyya

rows.output: Sainsbury's na fafatawa da Boots, Superdrug da Debenhams da shagunan kayan kwalliya irin na shagunan sashe, wadanda ma'aikatan kwararru ke kula da su.
rows.reference: Sainsbury’s yana ɗaukan Boots, Superdrug da Debenhams tare da irin ɓangarorin shagon salon kwalliya da aka ɗauka masa ma’aikata da ƙwararrun masu ba da taimako.

rows.output: Daraktan wasan motsa jiki na Jami'ar Jihar Louisiana Joe Alleva ya gode wa hukumomin tsaro na yankin bisa kokarinsu na "hankali da kuma bin adalci."
rows.reference: Daraktan wasan tsalle-tsalle na LSU Joe Alleva ya gode wa ma’aikatan doka na yankin don irin aikinsu na “jajircewa da ganin an yi adalci.”

rows.output: Sims yana da shekaru ashirin.

rows.output: Mai tsaron gaba mai ƙafa 6-6 ya girma a Baton Rouge, inda mahaifinsa, Wayne, ya kuma buga kwallon kwando a Jami'ar Jihar Louisiana (LSU).
rows.reference: Mai tsawon tattaki 6 da 6 ya girma ne a cikin Baton Rouge, inda mahaifinsa, Wayne, shi ma ya buga wasan ƙwallon kwando ga LSU.

rows.output: Ya yi matsakaicin maki 5.6 da 2.6 a kowane wasa a kakar da ta gabata.
rows.reference: Yana da matsakaicin maki 5.6 da sake dawo da ƙididdigar ci na 2.6 a wani na lokacin da shuɗe.

rows.output: A safiyar Juma'a, kociyan kwallon kwando na Jami'ar Jihar Louisiana (LSU) Will Wade ya ce kungiyar ta "bata" kuma "ta cikin kaduwa" da mutuwar Wayde.

rows.output: "Wannan shine abin da kuke damuwa da shi a kowane lokaci," Wade ya ce.

rows.output: Wani vulkan ya zubar da ash a kan birnin Mexico

rows.output: Garin Ash daga tsaunin Popocatepetl ya kai ga unguwannin kudu na babban birnin Mexico.
rows.reference: Toka da ke fesuwa daga babban dutsi mai amon wuta na Popocatepetl ta isa makwaɓta na kudancin babban birnin Mexico.

rows.output: Cibiyar Kasa da Kasa ta Gargaɗi kan Hana Bala'i ta gargadi 'yan kasar Mexico a ranar Asabar da su kauce wa tsaunin bayan da aka samu karuwar ayyukan a cikin kwarin kuma ya rubuta fitar da iskar gas da ash 183 a cikin sa'o'i 24.
rows.reference: Cibiyar Hana Haɗura ta Ƙasa ta gargaɗi ‘yan Mexico a ranar Asabar kar su kusanci dutsin bayan abin ya kai koli a farfashewar inda kuma a ka yi rijistar fitar da hayaƙi na iskar gas 183 da kuma toka ta fiye da sa’o’i 24.

rows.output: Cibiyar tana kula da rurin da girgizar kasa da yawa.
rows.reference: Cibiyar tana kula da cidodi da girgize-girgizen ƙasa.

rows.output: Hotuna a shafukan sada zumunta sun nuna yadda guntun guntun ash ke rufe tagogin motoci a unguwanni daban-daban na birnin Mexico kamar Xochimilco.
rows.reference: Hotuna a hanyar sadarwa ta zumunta sun nuna mashimfiɗu marassa kauri na toka suna danƙare a jikin gilasan mota a cikin makwaɓta na Birnin Mexico kamar su Xochimilco.

rows.output: Masana ilimin ƙasa sun lura da karuwar ayyukan a wani vulkan da ke da nisan mil 45 (72 km) kudu maso gabashin babban birnin kasar tun bayan da wani girgizar kasa mai karfin 7.1 ta afku a tsakiyar kasar Mexico a watan Satumba na shekarar 2017.
rows.reference: Masana kimiyyar yanayi sun lura da wani karin aiki a dutsin da ke zaune a mil 45 (kilomita 72) kudu-maso-gabas na babban birnin tun daga wata girgizar kasa da aka yi mai girman 7.1 da ta raguza tsakiyar Mexico a Satumba 2017.

rows.output: An fara aikin wutar wuta mai suna "Don Goyo" tun daga shekarar 1994.
rows.reference: Dutsi mai amon wutar da ake kira "Don Goyo" ya daɗe yana tashi tun 1994.

rows.output: Rundunar ‘yan sanda sun yi artabu da masu fafutukar kafa kasar Catalan a gaban bikin shekaru 1 da aka yi na kada kuri’ar raba kai.
rows.reference: ’Yan sanda sun yi arangama da masu neman ɓallewa na Catalan kafin zagayowar bikin neman ‘yanci

rows.output: An kama mutane shida a Barcelona a ranar Asabar bayan da masu fafutukar neman 'yancin kai suka yi ta kai hari kan 'yan sanda, a daidai lokacin da dubban mutane suka halarci zanga-zangar da suka yi a gaba da gaba domin tunawa da shekara ta farko da Catalonia ta gudanar da zaben raba kai.
rows.reference: An kama mutane shida a Barcelona a ranar Asabar bayan masu zanga-zangar nuna goyon bayan ‘yanci sun yi fito-na-fito tare da ‘yan sandan kwantar da tarzoma, kuma kamar yadda dubun-dubata suka shiga zanga-zanga ta adawa da juna don bikin zagayowar ranar kaɗa kuri’a da ta raba Catalonia a kan ɓallewa.

rows.output: Wani rukuni na masu kare 'yancin kai da suka rufe fuska sun tsaya tsayin daka a gaban 'yan sanda masu tayar da hankali, inda suka jefa su da kwai, suka yi ta harbin fenti, inda suka haifar da duhun hayaki a tituna da ake yawan cunkoso da masu yawon bude ido.
rows.reference: Wani gungu masu goyon bayan ɓallewar da suka rufe idanuwansu da ‘yan sanda suka riƙe sun jefe su da koyaye da kuma watsa musu fentin foda, inda suka ƙirƙiri wasu gajimare mai duhu a cikin titunan da yawanci sukan cika maƙil da ‘yan yawon shaƙatawa.

rows.output: An yi artabu a baya a ranar guda da kuma ‘yan sanda sun yi amfani da sandunansu wajen shawo kan lamarin.
rows.reference: Faɗace-faɗace sun ɓarke a ranar daga baya inda ‘yan sanda suka yi amfani da kulaƙensu don hana faɗan.

rows.output: A cikin sa'o'i da dama, kungiyoyin da ke goyon bayan 'yancin kai sun yi ihu "Babu mantawa, babu gafara" a gaban masu zanga-zangar hadin kai suna ihu "Rayuwa a Spain."
rows.reference: Har fiye da tsawon sa’o’i masu yawa gungu-gungun masu goyon bayan ɓallewar suna amshi “Babu mantuwa, babu yafiya” sun yi rikici da masu zanga-zanga ‘yan son haɗewa suna ihu, Allah ya ja kwanan Spain.”

rows.output: Maza 14 sun samu magani saboda raunukan da ba su da yawa da aka samu a yayin zanga-zangar, a cewar kafafen yada labarai na gida.
rows.reference: An yi magani a mutane goma sha huɗu don ƙananan raunuka da suka ji a zanga-zangogi, kamar yadda kafofin watsa labarai na gida suka ba da rahoto.

rows.output: Tashin hankali ya ci gaba da kasancewa a yankin da ke son yin garambawul shekara guda bayan kuri'ar raba gardama da aka gudanar a ranar 1 ga Oktoba, wanda gwamnatin Madrid ta yi la'akari da shi ba daidai ba, amma 'yan kasar Catalonia sun yi bikin.
rows.reference: Har yanzu da tashin hankali sosai a lardin da ya sa ‘yanci a zuciyarsa shekara ɗaya bayan zaɓen raba gardama na 1 ga Oktoba wanda Madrid ke ɗauka ba ya bisa doka amma ‘yan Catalan masu neman ɓallewa ke ta yin murna da shi.

rows.output: Masu jefa kuri'a sun zabi da gagarumin rinjaye su zama masu zaman kansu, duk da cewa an samu karancin fitowar masu kada kuri'a, inda wadanda suka kada kuri'a suka yi watsi da zaben.
rows.reference: Masu jefa kuri’ar sun yi zaɓe sosai inda suka zaɓi ‘yanci kodayake ba a fito sosai ba inda waɗanda ba sa son ɓallewa suka ƙauracewa zaɓen.

rows.output: A cewar hukumomin Catalan, sama da mutane 1000 ne suka jikkata a shekarar da ta gabata bayan da ‘yan sanda suka yi yunkurin dakile zaben a rumfunan zabe a fadin yankin a lokacin da ake fama da tashin hankali.
rows.reference: A cewar hukumomin Catalan an aƙalla raunata mutane 1000 ne shekarar da ta wuce bayan ‘yan sanda sun yi ƙoƙarin su tsaida kaɗa kuri’ar da ake yi a wuraren jefa kuri’ar a dukkan faɗin lardin a cikin gumurzun tashin hankali.

rows.output: Ƙungiyoyin da ke goyon bayan 'yancin kai sun yi sansani a daren Juma'a don hana zanga-zangar goyon bayan 'yan sandan ƙasa.
rows.reference: Gungu-gungu na masu nuna goyon bayan ‘yanci sun yi dandazo waje da dare suna goyon baya na ‘yan sandan ƙasa.

rows.output: An gudanar da zanga-zangar amma an tilasta musu su dauki wata hanya ta daban.
rows.reference: Zanga-zangar ta ci gaba amma an tilasta mata ɗaukan wata hanya daban.

rows.output: Narcis Termes, mai shekaru 68, mai aikin lantarki da ya halarci zanga-zangar neman ‘yancin kai tare da matarsa, ya ce bai yi tsammanin Catalonia za ta samu ‘yancin kai ba.
rows.reference: Narcis Termes, mai shekaru 68, wani latirisha da ke halartar zanga-zangar ‘yan neman ɓallewar tare da matarsa ya ce ba ya kuma fatan ganin yiwuwar Catalonia ta sami ‘yanci.

rows.output: "Shekarar da ta gabata muka yi ta cikin daya daga cikin lokutan da muka fi so.
rows.reference: “Shekarar da ta wuce mun rayu a cikin ɗaya daga cikin lokacinmu mafi kyau.

rows.output: Na kalli iyayena suna kuka da farin ciki saboda suna da damar kada kuri'a, amma yanzu muna makale," in ji shi.
rows.reference: Na kalli iyayena suna kukan murna saboda damar jefa kuri’a amma yanzu mun tsaya ciki,” inji shi.

rows.output: Duk da cewa sun tafiyar da nasara mai matukar muhimmanci, ko da yake karama, a zaben yankin da aka yi a watan Disamba na baya, jam'iyyun kishin kasa na Catalonia sun yi gwagwarmaya don ci gaba da samun karfin gwiwa a wannan shekarar, yayin da mutane da yawa daga cikin shugabanninsu da aka fi sani da su suka yi gudun hijira da kansu ko kuma a tsare a jiran shari'a saboda rawar da suka taka wajen shirya zaben da kuma shelanta 'yancin kai.
rows.reference: Duk da gudanar da wata muhimmiyar nasara ko da tsukekkiya ce a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan yankin a Disamba da ta wuce, jam’iyyun da ke goyon bayan ‘yanci na Catalan sun yi gwagwarmaya don su ci gaba da hazaƙar wannan shekarar tare da yawancin sanannun fitattun shugabanninsu ko dai sun tafi neman mafakar da suka sa kansu ko an kame su suna jiran shari’a don rawarsu da suka taka a cikin shirya zaɓen raba gardamar da furuci na ‘yanci da suka yi daga baya.

rows.output: Joan Puig, wani mai shekaru 42 mai aikin gyaran mota, wanda ke rubuta zanga-zangar goyon bayan ‘yan sanda a wayarsa, ya ce rikicin ya taso ne daga bangarorin siyasa biyu.
rows.reference: Joan Puig, wani makanike mai shekaru 42 da ke daukan zanga-zanga a cikin goyon baya na ‘yan sanda a kan tarho dinsa, ya ce rikicin ya sami ruruwa ne daga ‘yan siyasa da ke dukkan bangarorin.

rows.output: "Yana ƙara ƙara damuwa," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Yana ƙara ƙazanta sosai,” inji shi.

rows.output: A ranar Asabar, Oriol Junqueras, daya daga cikin shugabannin Catalonia tara da ke tsare a gidan yari tun daga karshen shekarar da ta gabata, ya sanar da cewa zai tsaya takarar zaben majalisar Turai a shekara mai zuwa.
rows.reference: A ranar Asabar, Oriol Junqueras, ɗaya daga shugabanni tara na Catalan da ke tsare kafin a fara shari’a tun ƙarshen shekarar da ta wuce, ya sanar cewa zai tsaya zaɓuɓɓukan Majalisar Dokoki ta Turai a shekara mai zuwa.

rows.output: "Tsayawa takara a zaben Turai hanya ce mafi kyau ta nuna adawa da koma bayan dabi'un dimokuradiyya da zalunci da muka gani daga gwamnatin Sipaniya," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Tsayawa a matsayin wani ɗan takara don zaɓuɓɓukan Turai shi ne hanya mafi kyau ta kin koma baya a kimomin dimokuraɗiyya da zalunci da muka gani daga gwamnatin Spain,” inji shi.

rows.output: Londonderry: Mutanen da aka kama bayan motar ta shiga gidan

rows.output: Mutane uku, masu shekaru 33, 34, da 39, an kama su ne bayan an tunkari mota a gidan a Londonderry.
rows.reference: An kama wasu maza, masu shekaru 33, 34 da 29, bayan an ta maimaita doka wata ƙaramar mota zuwa cikin wani gida a da ke Londonderry.

rows.output: Lamarin ya faru ne a Ballynagard Crescent a ranar Alhamis da misalin karfe 19:30 na safe.
rows.reference: Abin ya faru ne a cikin Ballynagard Crescent a ranar Alhamis da kusan ƙarfe 19:30 BST.

rows.output: Det Insp Bob Blemmings ya ce an lalata kofofin kuma ginin da kansa.
rows.reference: Mataimakin Sufeto Bob Blemmings ya ce an lalata ƙofofi da ma gidan kansa.

rows.output: Wani kuma zai iya harba wani katon kibiya a motar a wani lokaci.
rows.reference: An kuma harba ƙila kwari da baka a kan ƙaramar motar a wani lokaci.

rows.output: Menga ya buga kwallo a raga ya ba Livingston nasara 1-0 a kan Rangers
rows.reference: Cin da Menga ya yi ba wa Livingston nasara 1 da 0 a kan Rangers

rows.output: Dolly Menga ta zura kwallo ta farko ga Livingston ta samu nasara
rows.reference: Cin ƙwallon Dolly Menga ya ba wa Livingston samun nasara

rows.output: An yi wa Livingston kwarin gwiwa, ya baiwa Rangers mamaki, ya kuma sa Steven Gerrard ya yi rashin nasara na biyu a wasanni 18 da ya yi a matsayin manajan kulob din Ibrox.
rows.reference: Livingston da aka ƙara wa girma ta ba da mamaki ga Rangers inda ta ajiye Steven Gerrard kawai zuwa ga cinsa da aka yi karo na biyu a cikin wasanni 18 a matsayinsa na manaja na kulob ɗin Ibrox.

rows.output: Kwallon da Dolly Menga ta yi ta zama bambamcin da ya yi, yayin da Gary Holt's side ta yi daidai da Hibernian a matsayi na biyu.
rows.reference: Harin da Dolly Menga ya yi ya kasance abin da kawo bambanci saboda ɓangaren Gary Holt ya motsa lebur tare da Hibernian a cikin mataki na biyu.

rows.output: Kungiyar Gerrard har yanzu ba ta samu nasara a waje a gasar Premiership a wannan kakar ba, kuma za ta fuskanci kungiyar Hearts, wadda take bayan su da maki takwas, a ranar Lahadi mai zuwa.
rows.reference: Ɓangaren Gerrard yana nan ba tare da wata nasara da zai ta fi da ita ba a cikin wasan Premiership ɗin wannan lokacin kuma zai fuskanci Leaders Hearts, waɗanda suke bi da digo takwas, Lahadi mai zuwa.

rows.output: Kafin haka, Rangers suna karbar bakuncin Rapid Vienna a gasar Europa a ranar Alhamis.
rows.reference: Kafin nan, Rangers sun karɓi Rapid Vienna a cikin wasan Europa League a ranar Alhamis.

rows.output: Livingston, a halin yanzu, sun tsawaita wasannin da ba su yi rashin nasara ba a gasar zuwa wasanni shida, inda koci Holt bai taba yin rashin nasara ba tun da ya maye gurbin Kenny Miller a watan da ya gabata.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ake ciki hakan, Livinsgton, sun kara matsayinsu na ba wanda ya doke su a cikin shiyyar zuwa wasanni shida, tare da shugaban horar da wasa Holt har yanzu don ɗanɗana dokewa tun da ya maye gurbin Kenny Miler wata da ya wuce.

rows.output: Livingston sun rasa damar da suka samu a kan baƙi masu ƙarfi
rows.reference: Livingston sun rasa damammaki a kan maziyartansu da ba su dama

rows.output: Tawagar Holt ta kasance a gaba tun da dadewa kafin ta zura kwallo, saboda hanyoyin kai hari da suka haifar wa Rangers matsaloli da dama.
rows.reference: Ya kamata a ce ƙungiyar Holt suna gaba ne kafin su ci, tare da fuskantar tasu wanda ke haifar wa Rangers matsaloli iri-iri.

rows.output: Scott Robinson ya karya shingen, amma ya yi yunkurin tura kwallon a fuskar raga, sannan Alan Lithgow ya yi kokarin tura kwallon a waje bayan ya yi tsalle ya hadu da kai da Craig Halkett ya yi a kan raga.
rows.reference: Scott Robinson ya shige ciki amma ya ja ƙoƙarinsa ta gaban fuska ta cin nasara, shi ke nan Alan Lithgow kawai zai iya fuskantar da ƙoƙarinsa bayan yin ƙasa don haɗuwa da bugu da ka na cin Craig Halkett.

rows.output: Masu masaukin baki sun gamsu su bar Rangers su buga a gabansu, suna sane da cewa za su iya damun baƙi a lokacin da za a yi wasa.
rows.reference: Masu saukan bakin sun yarda su bar Rangers su buga wasa a gabansu, suna sane da cewa za su iya wahalar da masu ziyarar a jerin ɗaiɗaiku.

rows.output: Kuma haka ne aka samu muhimmin burin.
rows.reference: Kuma wancan shi ne yadda ci mai muhimmancin ya gudana.

rows.output: An ba wa Rangers bugun daga kai sai mai tsaron gida, kuma Livingston ya yi amfani da shi, Declan Gallagher da Robinson sun hada kai don sa Menga, wanda ya dauki kwallon sannan ya zura kwallo daga tsakiyar ramin.
rows.reference: Rangers sun amince da bugun da ba tarewa kuma Livingston suka yi aiki da wata dama, Declan Gallagher da Robinson suka haɗe suka tsara Menga, wanda ya taɓa da kuma ci daga tsakiya ta akwatin.

rows.output: A wannan matakin, Rangers sun mamaye mallakar kwallo amma sun gano cewa tsaron gida ya yi kauri, kuma mai tsaron gida Liam Kelly ba a damu da shi sosai.
rows.reference: A wannan mataki, Rangers ta mamaye riƙe ƙwallo amma ta sami tsaron gidan ba zai ba da damar wucewa ba kuma mai kama ƙwallo Liam Kelly kuma gaba ɗaya bai damu ba.

rows.output: Wannan tsarin ya ci gaba zuwa rabin na biyu, kodayake Alfredo Morelos ya tilasta wa Kelly ya yi tsalle.
rows.reference: Wannan yanayi ya ci gaba har rabi na biyu, kodayake Alfredo Morelos ya tilasta wani ceto daga Kelly.

rows.output: An hana Scott Pittman da ƙafafun mai tsaron gida Allan McGregor na Rangers da kuma Lithgow ya yi kuskure daga wani tsari na kai hari na Livingston.
rows.reference: Scott Pittman bai samu dama ba daga ƙafa ta mai kama ƙwallo na Rangers Allan McGregor kuma Lithgow ya buɗa sosai daga wani wasan da Livingston ya tsara.

rows.output: Kwallaye sun ci gaba da shiga cikin akwatin Livingston kuma ana ci gaba da share su, yayin da aka yi ikirarin biyu na hukunci - bayan kalubalen Halkett kan wanda ya maye gurbin Glenn Middleton, da kuma wanda aka yi wa hannu - an yi watsi da su.
rows.reference: Sai kuma bugu ta ko’ina da suka riƙa zuwa cikin akwatin Livingston inda kuma a ci gaba da maganinsu, a yayin da aka samu bugu daga kai sai gola - bayan ƙalubalantar Halkett a kan maye gurbin Glenn Middleton, kuma ɗaya don taɓawa da hannu - inda aka ture gefe.

rows.output: 'Phenomenal' daga Livingston - nazari

rows.output: BBC Scotland's Alasdair Lamont a filin wasan Tony Macaroni

rows.output: Wani aiki mai ban mamaki da sakamako ga Livingston.
rows.reference: Wani wasa mai ban mamaki da sakamako don Livingston.

rows.output: Ga mutum, sun kasance masu kyau sosai, suna ci gaba da wuce tsammanin a kan wannan hanyar tashi.
rows.reference: Ga wani mutum, sun burge sosai, suna ci gaba da wuce abin da ake tsammani a kan wannan abin da ya yi saman.

rows.output: Salon wasan su da kuma ‘yan wasan su sun yi kadan ba su canza tun lokacin da suka dawo gasar firimiya ba, amma babban yabo ya kamata a bai wa Holt don yadda ya farfado da kungiyar tun lokacin da ya isa.
rows.reference: Irin salonsu na wasa da ma’aikata ya dan canza tun da dawowarsu zuwa saman matsayi, amma babban yabo ya kamata ya je ne ga Holt da irin hanyar da ya haɗa ƙungiyar tun zuwansa.

rows.output: Ya yi wa mutane da yawa hidima.
rows.reference: Yana da gwarzaye da yawa.

rows.output: Kyaftin Halkett ya yi girma, yana tara wani kariya mai kyau, yayin da Menga ya ci gaba da tunkarar Connor Goldson da Joe Worrall a duk lokacin.
rows.reference: Kyaftin Halkett ya shirya, inda ya yi ta tsara wani tsaro mai kyau, a lokacin da Menga ya sa Connor Goldson da Joe Worrall suka kasance a kan ƙafafunsu gaba ɗaya.

rows.output: Rangers sun yi ƙarancin wahayi, duk da haka.
rows.reference: Rangers sun kusan rasa ƙarfin gwiwa, kusan.

rows.output: Kamar yadda suka yi kyau a wasu lokuta a karkashin jagorancin Gerrard, sun yi kasa da yawa daga wadannan ka'idoji.
rows.reference: Duk da irin yadda suke da kyau a lokutan a ƙarƙashin Gerrard, sun gaza samun irin wadannan daidaituwar.

rows.output: Kwallon karshe nasu ta yi kasa - kawai sau daya suka yi ta karya layin tsaron gida - kuma hakan wani gargaɗi ne ga Rangers, wadanda suke tsakiyar teburin.
rows.reference: Ƙwallonsu ta ƙarshe ba ta isa ba - kawai sau ɗaya ne suka yanke gefen gidan a buɗe - kuma wani abu ne na wartsakarwar kira ga Rangers, waɗanda suka sami kansu a cikin tsakiyar teburi.

rows.output: An yi wa Erdogan karbuwa a Cologne
rows.reference: Erdogan ya sami wata irin karɓa a Cologne

rows.output: An yi murmushi da sararin sama mai shuɗi a ranar Asabar (29 ga Satumba) lokacin da shugabannin Turkiyya da Jamus suka gana a wajen karin kumallo a Berlin.
rows.reference: An ga murmurshi iri-iri da shuɗin sararin samaniya a ranar Asabar (29 ga Satumba) inda shugabannin Turkiyya da Jamus suka haɗu don cin kumallon safe a cikin Berlin.

rows.output: Yau ne ranar ƙarshe na ziyarar shugaban ƙasar Erdogan mai jayayya a Jamus - wadda aka yi niyya don gyara dangantaka tsakanin abokan tarayya na NATO.

rows.output: "Lokacin da aka tayar da hankali game da tsunami jiya, mutane har yanzu suna yin ayyukansu a bakin teku kuma ba su gudu nan take ba, kuma sun zama wadanda abin ya shafa," in ji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar kula da bala'i ta kasar Indonesia BNPB a wani taron manema labarai a Jakarta.
rows.reference: “A yayin da barazanar tsunamin ta taso jiya, mutane a lokacin suna ayyukansu ne a kan bakin tekun kuma ba su gudu nan da nan ba inda suka zama waɗanda abin ya shafa,” inji Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, mai magana da yawun hukumar rage haɗura ta Indonesiya ta BNPB a cikin wata gajeruwar ganawa da ‘yan jarida a cikin Jakarta.

rows.output: "Ba a yi tsalle ba, ya ɗauki motoci, itatuwa, gidaje, ya buga komai a ƙasa," in ji Nugroho, yana ƙara cewa tsunami ya yi tafiya a cikin teku mai buɗewa da gudun kilomita 800 a cikin sa'a (kilomita 497) kafin ya bugi bakin teku.
rows.reference: “Tsunamin tazo da kanta ne, ta jawo ƙananan motoci, katakwaye, gidaje, ta kuma bugi duk abin da ke kan ƙasa,” inji Nugroho, inda ya kara da cewa tsunami ta yi tafiya a faɗin buɗeɗɗen teku da gudu na kilomita 800 kowace sa’a (mil 497 kowace sa’a) kafin ta sauka a bakin tekun.

rows.output: Wasu mutane sun hau bishiyoyi don tserewa daga tsunami kuma suka tsira, ya ce.
rows.reference: Wasu mutanen sun hau bishiyoyi ne don tsira daga tsunami kuma sun rayu, inji shi.

rows.output: Kimanin mutane 16,700 an kwashe su zuwa cibiyoyi 24 a Palu.
rows.reference: An kwashe kusan mutane 16,700 zuwa cibiyoyi 24 da ke cikin Palu.

rows.output: Hotunan jirgin sama da hukumar bala'i ta fitar sun nuna cewa an lalata gine-gine da shaguna da dama, an karkatar da gada kuma an ruguje, an kuma kewaye da wani masallaci da ruwa.
rows.reference: Hotunan da aka ɗauka daga sama da hukumar haɗarin ta sake sun nuna gine-gine da shaguna a lalace, gadojin sun lankwashe da rushewa da wani masallaci ruwa ya kewaye shi.

rows.output: An ci gaba da girgizar kasa a cikin birnin bakin teku a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: An ci gaba da samun girgize-girgize na baya da suka addabi birnin da ke kusa da tekun a ranar Asabar.

rows.output: An yi jerin girgizar kasa a yankin da ke da mutane miliyan 2.4.
rows.reference: An ji girgize-girgizen ƙasa a jere a wani yanki mai mutane miliyan 2 da dubu ɗari 4.

rows.output: Hukumar tantancewa da amfani da fasahar Indonesia (BPPT) ta ce a cikin wata sanarwa cewa, makamashin da aka saki a ranar Jumma'a ya kai kusan sau 200 fiye da makamin atomic da aka jefa a Hiroshima a lokacin yakin duniya na biyu.
rows.reference: Hukumar Auna da Aiwatar da Fasaha ta Indonesiya (BPPT) a cikin wata sanarwa ta ce ƙarfi da babbar girgizar ƙasa ta sake a ranar Jumu’ar ya kai kusan sau 200 na ƙarfin bam na sinadarin atom da aka jefa a kan Hiroshima a cikin Yakin Duniya na Biyu.

rows.output: Yankin birnin, wanda ke kusa da ƙarshen wani kunkuntar tashar jiragen ruwa, na iya kara girman tsunami, in ji.
rows.reference: Yanayi na birnin, wanda ke zaune a ƙarshe na wani ɗan ƙaramin ziri mai tsawo, ƙila shi ya faɗaɗa girma na tsunami ɗin, inji ta.

rows.output: Nugroho ya bayyana barnar a matsayin "mai yawa" kuma ya ce dubban gidaje, asibitoci, shaguna, da otal-otal sun ruguje.
rows.reference: Nugroho ya bayyana lalacewar a matsayin “mai yawa” kuma ya ce dubun-dubata na gidaje, asibitoci, shagunan cinikayya da otel-otel duk sun ruguje.

rows.output: An gano gawarwakin wasu wadanda abin ya shafa sun makale a karkashin tarkacen gine-ginen da suka ruguje, ya ce, ya kuma bayyana cewa mutane 540 sun jikkata kuma 29 sun bace.
rows.reference: An sami gawarwakin waɗanda abin ya shafa a maƙale a ƙarƙashin gine-gine da suka rushe, inji shi, ya kuma ƙara da cewa mutane 540 sun ji rauni kuma an rasa 29.

rows.output: Nugroho ya ce, wadanda suka mutu da kuma barnar da aka yi na iya zama mafi girma a bakin teku mai tazarar kilomita 300 (mil 190) a arewa da Palu, wani yanki mai suna Donggala, wanda ke kusa da epicenter na girgizar kasa.
rows.reference: Nugroho ya ce yawan masu mutuwar da lalacewar zai ƙaru sosai a layin bakin teku kilomita 300 (mil 190) arewa da Palu, wani yanki da ake kira Donggala,

rows.output: Hanyoyin sadarwa sun kasance gaba daya cikin kunci ba tare da wani bayani ba" daga Donggala, in ji Nugroho.
rows.reference: Sadarwa “gaba ɗaya sun tsaya cik kuma babu labari” daga Donggala, jinji Nugroho.

rows.output: Akwai sama da mutane 300,000 da ke zaune a wurin," kungiyar Red Cross ta ce a cikin wata sanarwa, inda ta kara da cewa ma'aikatansu da masu sa kai suna kan hanyar zuwa yankunan da abin ya shafa.
rows.reference: Akwai fiye da mutane 300,000 da ke zauna a can,” inji ƙungiyar agaji ta Red Cross a cikin wata sanarwa, tana mai ƙarin cewa ma’aikatanta da masu sa-kai sun nufi yankunan da abin ya shafa.

rows.output: "Wannan ya riga ya zama bala'i, amma zai iya kara tabarbarewa," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Wannan tuni wani bala’i ne, amma zai iya ƙara muni,” inji ta.

rows.output: Hukumar ta fuskanci suka a ranar Asabar kan rashin sanar da cewa wani tsunami ya afkawa Palu, duk da cewa jami'ai sun ce igiyoyin sun zo a cikin lokacin da aka fitar da gargadin.
rows.reference: An soki hukumar a ranar Asabar sosai don rashin sanarwa cewa wata tsunami za ta afka wa Palu, kodayake jami’ai sun ce igiyoyin ruwa sun zo a tsakanin lokacin da aka fitar da gargaɗin.

rows.output: A cikin bidiyon da ba na kwararru ba da aka raba a shafukan sada zumunta, wani mutum a bene na sama na wani gini ana jin yana yi wa mutane a titin da ke kasa gargadi cikin gaggawa game da igiyar ruwa mai gabatowa.
rows.reference: Wani bidiyon da ba ƙwararre ba da aka raba ta kafar sada zumunta za a iya jin wani mutum a kan saman daɓe na wani gini yana ihun girgiza gargaɗi na kusantowar tsunami ga mutane da ke titin ƙasan.

rows.output: A cikin mintuna, katanga na ruwa ta yi karo da bakin teku, tana ɗauke da gine-gine da motoci.
rows.reference: A cikin mintina wani bango na ruwa ya faɗo a kan tekun, yana ɗaukewa gine-gine da ƙananan motoci.

rows.output: Reuters ba a iya tabbatar da gaggawar gani nan take.
rows.reference: Kamfanin dillacin labarai na Reuters ba iya tantance bidiyon ba nan da nan.

rows.output: Guguwar ta haifar da katsewar wutar lantarki mai mahimmanci da ta katse hanyoyin sadarwa a kusa da Palu, wanda ya sa ya zama da wahala ga hukumomi su tsara ayyukan ceto.
rows.reference: Girgizar ƙasar da tsunamin sun haifar da katsewar lantarki da yanke sadarwa a kewayen Palu inda ya haifar da wahala ga hukumomi wajen haɗin gamayyar ƙoƙare-ƙoƙare na ceto.

rows.output: An fara aika jiragen kaya da agajin da sojoji suka kawo daga Jakarta da wasu garuruwa, a cewar hukumomi, amma wadanda suka tsere har yanzu suna bukatar abinci da sauran bukatun asali.
rows.reference: Sojoji sun fara aika manyan jiragen ɗaukan kaya da tallafi daga Jakarta da sauran birane, inji hukumomi, amma waɗanda aka kwashen har yanzu suna sosai buƙatar abinci da sauran muhimman kayayyaki.

rows.output: An bude filin jirgin saman birnin ne kawai don ayyukan agaji kuma har yanzu an rufe shi har zuwa Oktoba.
rows.reference: An sake buɗe filin jirgin sama na birnin kaɗai don ƙoƙare-ƙoƙaren kayan agaji kuma zai kasance a rufe sai har Octoba.

rows.output: Shugaban Joko Widodo ya shirya ziyartar cibiyoyin tserewa a Palu a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: An tsara Shugaba Joko Widodo zai ziyarci cibiyoyin kwashewa mutane a cikin Palu a ranar Lahadi.

rows.output: Indonesia: Mutanen da suka rasa rayukansu sun kai sama da 800.
rows.reference: Ƙididdigar Mutuwar Tsunami a Indonesiya Ta Haura 800

rows.output: Yana da Muni sosai.
rows.reference: Abin Ya Ɓaci Sosai.

rows.output: Yayin da ma'aikatan Vision na Duniya daga Donggala suka isa birnin Palu cikin aminci, inda ma'aikata ke kwana a cikin tarkacen tarkace da aka kafa a cikin fadar ofishinsu, sun ga al'amura mai ban tausayi a kan hanyar, in ji Mista Doseba.
rows.reference: Kodayake ma’aikatan World Vision sun koma birnin Palu lafiya ƙalau daga Donggala, inda ma’aikatan ke zaune a matsugunan tanfol da aka kafa a farfajiyar ofishin nasu, sun nuna wani hali na rugujewa a kan hanyar, inji Mista Doseba.

rows.output: "Sun gaya mini sun ga gidaje da yawa da aka lalata."
rows.reference: “Sun faɗa mun sun ga gidaje da yawa da suka rushe,” inji shi.

rows.output: Yana da muni sosai.
rows.reference: Abin ya ɓaci sosai.

rows.output: Ko da yake kungiyoyin agaji sun fara aikin da ke da wahala na fara injin agajin bala'i, wasu sun yi korafi cewa masu aikin agaji na kasashen waje da suka kware sosai sun hana su tafiya zuwa Palu.
rows.reference: Duk da gungu-gungun ‘yan agaji da suka fara wata babbar hoɓɓasa ta fara aikin tallafi na bala’i, wasu sun yi ƙorafi cewa ma’aikatan agaji na waje da ke ƙwarewa sosai ana hana su tafiya zuwa Palu.

rows.output: Bisa ga ka'idojin Indonesia, kudade, kayan aiki, da ma'aikata daga kasashen waje za su iya fara gudana ne kawai idan wurin bala'i an bayyana shi a matsayin yankin bala'i na kasa.
rows.reference: A cewar ƙa’idojin Indonesiya, kashe kuɗaɗe, samarwa da ba da ma’aikata daga ƙasashen waje kawai zai fara ne idan an furta wuri na fitina a matsayin zango na bala’i na ƙasa.

rows.output: Har yanzu ba a faru da shi ba.
rows.reference: Hakan har yanzu bai faru ba.

rows.output: "Har yanzu bala'i ne na matakin lardi," in ji Aulia Arriani, mai magana da yawun kungiyar agaji ta Indonesia.
rows.reference: “Har yanzu wani lebur ne yankin bala’i,” inji Aulia Arriani, mai magana da yawun Red Cross ta Indonesiya.

rows.output: "Da zarar gwamnati ta ce, "Lafiya, wannan wani bala'i ne na kasa," za mu iya bude don taimakon kasa da kasa amma har yanzu ba a samu matsayi ba."
rows.reference: Da zarar gwamnatin ta ce, “Ya yi, wannan zai zama wani bala’i na ƙasa,” za mu buɗe don taimakon ƙasa-da-ƙasa amma babu matsayin har yanzu.”

rows.output: Yayin da dare na biyu ya sauka a Palu bayan girgizar kasa da ambaliyar ruwa a ranar Juma'a, abokai da 'yan uwa na wadanda har yanzu ba a samu ba suna fatan cewa masoyansu za su zama abubuwan al'ajabi da za su sa labarun da ke cike da bakin ciki na bala'o'i na halitta su yi kyau.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda dare na biyu ya faɗa kan Palu bayan girgizar ƙasa da tsunami ta ranar Jumu’a, abokai da iyali na waɗanda suka ɓata suna ta fatan cewa ‘yan uwan nasu za su zama mu’ujizozi da za su rayar da layukan labari marar daɗi na bala’o’i na ƙasa.

rows.output: A ranar Asabar, an cire wani karamin yaro daga cikin bututun ruwa.
rows.reference: A ranar Asabar, an ciro wani ƙaramin yaro daga wata matattar datti.

rows.output: A ranar Lahadi ne, an ceto wata mata da aka makale a karkashin tarkacen gini tsawon kwanaki biyu tare da jikar mahaifiyarta a gefenta.
rows.reference: A ranar Lahadi, masu ceto sun ‘yantar da wata mata wanda ta kasance tana ƙarƙashin burbushi na kwanaki biyu tare da gawar mahaifiyarta kusa da ita.

rows.output: Gendon Subandono, babban koci na tawagar paragliding ta kasa ta Indonesia, ya horar da wasu ‘yan wasa biyu da suka bace a gasar wasannin Asiya, wadda ta kare a baya a kasar Indonesia.
rows.reference: Gendon Subandono, mai horar da ‘yan wasa na Ɗƙungiyar ‘yan sauka daga sama na Indonesiya, ya horar da ‘yan wasan biyu da suka bace na Wasannin Asiya, wanda aka gama a farkon wannan watan a cikin Indonesiya.

rows.output: Wasu daga cikin wadanda aka kama a otal din Roa Roa, ciki har da Mista Mandagi, dalibansa ne.
rows.reference: Saura daga cikin waɗanda aka rutsa da su a otel ɗin Roa Roa, har da Mista Mandagi, ɗalibansa ne.

rows.output: "A matsayin babban mutum a fagen tashi da saukar jirgin sama, ina da nauyin zuciya na," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “A matsayi wani babba a cikin wasan saukowa daga saman, ni ma ina nawa taƙaicin da nake ji,” inji shi.

rows.output: Mista Gendon ya ba da labarin yadda, a cikin sa'o'i bayan labarin rugujewar otal din Roa Roa ya bazu a tsakanin al'ummar paragliding, ya yi wa 'yan wasan Palu da ke halartar bikin bakin teku, wadanda suka yi ta hanyar saƙonnin WhatsApp.
rows.reference: Mista Gendon ya ba da bayanin yadda aka yi, a cikin sa’o’i bayan labarin rushewar otel ɗin Roa Roa da aka watsa a tsakanin al’ummar wasan saukowa daga saman, ya aika sakonnin WhatsApp a dugunzume zuwa masu gasa ta Palu, waɗanda ke shiga cikin bikin na bakin tekun.

rows.output: Saƙonninsa, duk da haka, sun haifar da alamar dubawa mai launin toka ɗaya kawai, maimakon ƙungiyoyin dubawa shuɗi.
rows.reference: Sakonninsa, kodayake, kawai sun haifar da alamar launin toka guda mai zane, a maimakon wani guda biyu na zane-zane shudi.

rows.output: Ina ganin hakan na nufin sakonnin ba a isar da su ba," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Ina jin yana nufi ba a aika sakonni ne ba,” inji shi.

rows.output: Mai satar kudi ya sace dala 26,750 a lokacin da ake cika ATM a Newport on the Levee
rows.reference: Ɓarayi sun ɗauki dala 26,750 a lokacin sake cika ATM a Newport a kan Daɓe

rows.output: An sace dala 26,750 daga ma’aikacin Brink’s da ke cika ATM a Newport on the Levee a safiyar Juma’a, a cewar wata sanarwa daga Sashen ‘Yan sanda na Newport.
rows.reference: Ɓarayi a ranar Juma’a da safe sun sace dala 26,750 daga wurin wani ma’aikacin Brink da ke sake cika wani ATM a Newport a kan Daɓe, a cewar wani labari da aka sake daga Ma’aikatar ‘Yan Sanda ta Newport.

rows.output: An tura direban motar da ya zubar da wani ATM a cikin hadin gwiwa da kuma shirin isar da karin kudi, Det. Dennis McCarthy ya rubuta a cikin sanarwar.
rows.reference: Direban ƙaramar motar yana cirewa wani ATM a cikin wani gini na nishaɗi da shiryawa don kawo ƙarin kuɗi, Det. Dennis McCarthy ya rubuta a cikin sanarwar.

rows.output: Yayin da yake cikin haka, wani mutum ya yi gudu daga bayan ma’aikacin Brink ya sace jaka da kudi da za a kai.
rows.reference: A lokacin da yake cikin aiki, wani mutum “ya zo a guje daga bayan ma’aikacin na Brink” kuma ya saci jakar kuɗi da za a kawo.

rows.output: Shaidu sun ga masu zargi da yawa suna gudu daga wurin, a cewar sanarwar, amma ‘yan sanda ba su bayyana adadin wadanda suka shiga lamarin ba.
rows.reference: Shaidun gani da ido sun ga waɗanda ake zargi da yawa suna gudu daga wurin da aka yi laifin a cewar sanarwar, amma ‘yan sanda ba su fayyace yawan waɗanda ke cikin ba.

rows.output: Wadanda suka san sunayensu su tuntubi ‘yan sandan Newport a 859-292-3680.

rows.output: Haka kuma, wani gajeren suna ne na sunan sana'arsa ta yanzu, West ya ce kalmar tana da muhimmanci a addini a gare shi.

rows.output: Na yi imani "kai" shine kalmar da aka fi amfani da ita a cikin Littafi Mai Tsarki, kuma a cikin Littafi Mai Tsarki yana nufin "ka," in ji West a baya a wannan shekara, yana tattaunawa kan taken kundin sa tare da mai gabatar da shirye-shiryen rediyo Big Boy.

rows.output: Mexico's AMLO ya yi alkawarin ba za a yi amfani da sojoji a kan farar hula ba
