rows.output: Shugaban kasar Mexico mai jiran gado Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawarin kada ya yi amfani da karfin soji a kan farar hula yayin da kasar ke gabatowa shekaru 50 da aka yi wa dalibai kisan kiyashi.
rows.reference: Zaɓaɓɓen Shugaban Ƙasar Mexico Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawarin ba zai taɓa yin amfani da ƙarfin soja a kan fararen hula ba a yayin da ƙasar ke kusantar cika shekaru 50 na wani murƙushewar da aka yi wa ɗalibai da aka zubar da jini.

rows.output: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari a ranar Asabar a filin Tlatelolco da ba zai taba amfani da sojoji wajen zaluntar al’ummar Mexico ba.
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari ranar Asabar a Tlatelolco Plaza “kar a taɓa ko kaɗan amfani da sojoji wajen murƙushe mutanen Mexico.”

rows.output: An harbe jami'an soji a wani zanga da ba ta da wuya a filin jirgin sama a ranar 2 ga Oktoba, 1968, inda suka kashe mutane kusan 300, a wani lokaci da kungiyoyin dalibai na hagu ke fara yaduwa a duk Latin Amurka.
rows.reference: Rundunonin sun yi harbi a kan wata zanga-zangar lumana a cibiyar a ranar 2 ga Oktoba, 1968, inda suka kashe da yawa har mutane 300 a wani lokaci yayin da ɗalibai ‘yan gwagwarmayar ra’ayin gurguzu suka fara samun matsuguni a Latin America.

rows.output: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari zai goyi bayan matasa 'yan Mexico ta hanyar bayar da tallafin wata-wata ga wadanda suke karatu da kuma bude karin jami'o'in gwamnati kyauta.
rows.reference: Lopez Obrador ya yi alkawari na goyon bayan samari ‘yan Mexico ta ba da tallafe-tallafe na wata-wata ga waɗanda ke karatu kuma da buɗe ƙarin jami’o’i na gwamnati kyauta.

rows.output: Ya ce rashin aikin yi da kuma rashin damar ilimi yana jawo matasa zuwa kungiyoyin masu aikata laifuka.
rows.reference: Ya kuma ce rashin aikin yi da wani rashi na damammakin ilmi su ne ke jan samari zuwa gungun ƙungiyoyi masu aikata laifi.

rows.output: Amurka ta ninka kudaden binciken A.I.
rows.reference: Ya kamata Amurka ta ruɓanya kuɗin A.I.

rows.output: Yayin da kasar Sin ke kara shiga harkar basirar wucin gadi, ya kamata Amurka ta ninka adadin kudaden da take kashewa wajen bincike a wannan fanni, in ji masu zuba jari da masu aikin AI Kai-Fu Lee, wanda ya yi aiki a Google, Microsoft da Apple.
rows.reference: Kamar yadda China ta zama tana aiki sosai a cikin hikimar da ba ta asali ba, ya kamata Amurka ta ruɓanya yawan abin da take kashewa a cikin nazari da ke cikin filin, inji mai zuba jari mai gwada hikimar da ba ta asalin ba Kai-Fu Lee, wanda ya yi aiki da Google, Microsoft da Apple.

rows.output: An yi sharhi ne bayan an yi ta cece-ku-ce a kan hukumomin Amurka da dama sun yi sanarwa game da AI, duk da cewa Amurka bata da wani tsari na hukuma na AI.
rows.reference: Sharhohin suna zuwa ne bayan ɓangarori da dama na gwamnatin Amurka sun yi furuci a kan AI na hikimar da ba ta asalin ba, duk da cewa Amurka ta rasa wata dabarar AI a  tsare.

rows.output: A lokaci guda, kasar Sin ta gabatar da shirinta a shekarar da ta gabata: tana da burin zama ta 1 a cikin kirkire-kirkire na AI kafin shekarar 2030.
rows.reference: A halin da ake cikin, China ta gabatar da shirinta shekarar da ta wuce: tana ƙoƙarin ta zama ta farko a cikin ƙago AI a shekara ta 2030.

rows.output: "Ƙara kasafin kuɗin binciken AI sau biyu zai zama kyakkyawan farawa, la'akari da cewa duk sauran ƙasashe suna da nisa a bayan Amurka, kuma muna neman sabon ci gaba a AI," in ji Lee.
rows.reference: “Ruɓanya kasafin kuɗi na AI zai zama wani mafari mai kyau, ganin cewa dukkan sauran ƙasashe sun yi gaba sosai a bayan Amurka kuma muna neman wani sabon abu a cikin AI,” inji Lee.

rows.output: Daidaita kudade na iya ninka yuwuwar cewa babban nasarar AI na gaba za a yi a Amurka, Lee ya gaya wa CNBC a wata hira da aka yi a wannan makon.
rows.reference: Ruɓanya kashe kuɗi zai iya rubanya damammaki inda za a cimma babban AI na gaba a cikin Amurka, Lee ya ce wa CNBC a cikin wata intabiyu wannan makon.

rows.output: Lee, wanda littafinsa mai suna "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order" ya fito a wannan watan ta Houghton Mifflin Harcourt, shugaban kamfanin Sinovation Ventures ne, wanda ya zuba jari a daya daga cikin manyan kamfanonin AI a kasar Sin, Face++.
rows.reference: Lee, wanda Houghton Mifflin Harcourt ya buga littafinsa "AI Superpowers: China, Silicon Valley and the New World Order"  wannan watan, shi ne Babban Shugaba na Sinovation Ventures China, wanda ya zuba jari a cikin daya daga sanannun kamfanonin AI a cikin China, Face++.

rows.output: A cikin 1980s a Jami'ar Carnegie Mellon, ya yi aiki kan tsarin AI wanda ya doke mafi kyawun dan wasan Othello na Amurka, daga baya kuma ya kasance babban jami'in bincike na Microsoft kuma shugaban rassa na Google na kasar Sin.
rows.reference: A cikin shekaru na 1980 a Jami’ar Carnegie Mellon ya yi aiki a kan wani tsarin AI da ya doke ɗan wasan Amurka Othello da ya fi matsayi, daga baya kuma ya zama wani zababben shugaba a Microsoft Research da shugaban Google na reshen China.

rows.output: Lee ta amince da gasar fasahar gwamnatin Amurka a baya kamar kalubalen binciken fasahar soji na DARPA da kuma tambayar lokacin da na gaba zai kasance, domin taimakawa wajen gano masu hangen nesa na gaba.
rows.reference: Lee ya faɗi gasa ta baya ta gwamnatin Amurka a kan fasaha kamar Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency's Robotics Challenge inda ya tambaya yaushe ne za a yi na gaban, saboda ya taimaka gane masu hange nesa na gaba.

rows.output: Masana a Amurka sukan yi aiki tuƙuru don samun tallafin gwamnati, in ji Lee.
rows.reference: Manazarta a cikin Amurka yawanci sukan yi aiki tuƙuru saboda cin taimakon kuɗaɗen gwamnati, inji Lee.

rows.output: "Ba kasar Sin ce ke daukar shugabannin ilimi ba; kamfanoni ne," in ji Lee.
rows.reference: “Ba China ne ke ɗaukewa shugabannin ilmi ba; kamfanoni ne,” inji Lee.

rows.output: Facebook, Google da sauran kamfanonin fasaha sun dauki gagarumin masana daga jami'o'i don yin aiki kan AI a cikin 'yan shekarun nan.
rows.reference: Facebook, Google da sauran kamfanonin fasaha sun ɗauki hayar manyan masu ilmi daga jami’o’i don aiki a kan AI a shekarun kwana nan.

rows.output: Lee ta ce canje-canjen manufofin shige da fice na iya taimakawa Amurka wajen karfafa kokarinta na AI.
rows.reference: Lee ya ce canje-canjen ƙudurin shiga ƙasa zai iya kuma taimakon Amurka ta daga ƙoƙare-ƙoƙarenta na AI.

rows.output: Ina ganin katunan kore su yi waɗanda suka yi digiri na uku a fannin AI.
rows.reference: “Ina jin ya kamata korayen katina su zama kai-tsaye ake samar da su ga masu digirin-digirgir a fannin hikimar AI da ba ta asali ba,” inji shi.

rows.output: An fitar da tsarin ci gaban fasahar wucin gadi na zamani daga Majalisar Ministoci ta kasar Sin a watan Yuli 2017.
rows.reference: Majalisar Ƙasar China ta fitar da Shirin Ci Gaban Hikimar Da Ba Ta Asali Don Al’ummar Gaba nata a cikin Yulin 2017.

rows.output: Asusun Kimiyya na Kasa na China yana ba da tallafi ga mutane a cibiyoyin ilimi iri ɗaya da Asusun Kimiyya na Kasa da sauran ƙungiyoyin gwamnati ke yi wa masu bincike na Amurka, amma ingancin aikin ilimi ya yi ƙasa da China, in ji Lee.
rows.reference: Gidauniyar Kimiyya na Halitta ta Ƙasa ta China ta samar da kuɗaɗe ga mutane a makarantun ilmi irin zuwa ga hanyar da Gidauniyar Kimiyyar ta Ƙasa da sauran hukumomin gwamnati ke ba da kuɗi ga manazartan Amurka, amma yanayin darajar aikin ilmi ya yi ƙasa a cikin China, inji Lee.

rows.output: A farkon wannan shekarar, Ma'aikatar Tsaron Amurka ta kafa Cibiyar Haɗin Gwiwar Hankali na Wucin Gadi, wacce aka yi niyya don haɗa abokan hulɗa daga masana'antu da ilimi, kuma Fadar White House ta sanar da kafa Kwamitin Zaɓe na Hankali na Wucin Gadi.
rows.reference: A farkon wannan shekarar Ma’aikatar Tsaro ta Amurka ta kafa wata Cibiyar Hikimar Da Ba Ta Asali Ba, wanda aka shirya don ta sa abokan hulɗa daga masana’anta da makaranta, kuma fadar White House ta sanar da ƙirƙirar wani Zaɓaɓɓen Kwamiti a kan Hikimar da ba ta asali ba.

rows.output: Kuma a wannan watan, DARPA ta sanar da zuba jarin dala biliyan 2 a wani shiri mai suna AI Na Gaba.
rows.reference: Kuma wannan watan DARPA ta sanar da zuba jarin dala biliyan 2 a cikin wani ƙoƙari da ake kira AI Next.

rows.output: Game da NSF, a halin yanzu tana saka hannun jari sama da dala miliyan 100 a duk shekara a binciken AI.
rows.reference: A game da NSF, a yanzu haka ta zuba jarin fiye da dala miliyan 100 a kowace shekara a cikin binciken AI.

rows.output: A lokaci guda, dokar Amurka da ke da nufin kafa wata hukumar tsaro ta kasa kan hankali na wucin gadi ba ta samu ci gaba ba cikin watanni.
rows.reference: A halin da ake ciki yanzu, dokar Amurka da ke neman ƙirƙirar wata Hukumar Tsaron Ƙasa kan Hikimar Da Ba Asali tana nan ba ta ga wani aiki ba a cikin watanni.

rows.output: Macedonians sun kada kuri'a a zaben da ya shafi ko za a canza sunan kasar
rows.reference: ‘Yan Macedonia suna jefa kuri’ar raba gardama a kan ko a canza sunan ƙasar

rows.output: An yi zaben a ranar Lahadi kan ko za a canza sunan kasar zuwa “Jamhuriyar Masedoniya ta Arewa,” wanda zai warware rikicin da ya dade da yawa da kasar Girka, wadda ta hana neman mambobinta a Tarayyar Turai da NATO.
rows.reference: Mutanen Macedonia sun jefa kuri’a a cikin wata raba gardama a ranar Lahadi ko ta canza sunanta zuwa “Jamhuriyyar Arewacin Macedonia,” a wani yinƙuri da zai warware wata tsohuwar taƙaddama tare da Greece wadda ta toshe nemanta na zama mamba don Tarayyar Turai da NATO.

rows.output: Girka, wadda ke da lardi mai suna Masedoniya, ta tabbatar da cewa sunan makwabtarta na arewa yana wakiltar ikirari kan yankinta, kuma ta hana shigarta cikin NATO da EU.
rows.reference: Greece, wadda ke da wani yanki da ake kira Macedonia, ya nace da cewa sunan makwabciyarta ta arewa yana wakiltar wani nema ne a kan iyakarta kuma ta hau-kujerar-na-ki na shiganta cikin NATO da Tarayyar Turai.

rows.output: Gwamnatocin biyu sun kulla yarjejeniya a watan Yuni bisa sunan da aka gabatar, amma masu adawa da sauyi sun ce canjin zai raunana asalin kabilanci na mafi yawan al’ummar Slavic na Masedoniya.
rows.reference: Gwamnatin biyu sun sami wata matsayi a Yuni a bisa wani sabon suna da suka ƙudurta, amma masu adawa na ‘yan kasanci sun yi mahawara canjin zai rage shaidar ƙabilanci na jama’a ‘yan Slav da suka yawa na Macedonia.

rows.output: Shugaban kasar Gjorge Ivanov ya ce ba zai kada kuri'a a zaben ba, kuma yakin neman zaben ya haifar da shakku ko za a cimma mafi karancin kashi 50 cikin 100 da ake bukata domin zaben ya yi inganci.
rows.reference: Shugaba Gjorge Ivanov ya ce ba zai yi zaɓe a cikin raba gardamar ba kuma wani kamfe na ƙauracewa ya sa shakku a kan ko yawan fitowar zai isa matsaikacin kashi 50 cikin ɗari da ake buƙata don raba gardamar ta inganta.

rows.output: Tambayar a kan kuri'ar raba gardama ta ce: "Kuna goyon bayan shiga NATO da EU tare da karɓar yarjejeniyar da Girka."
rows.reference: Tambayar da ke kan kuri’ar raba gardamar tana cewa: “Kai na NATO da zama mamban Tarayyar Turai ne da yarda da yarjejeniyar tare da Greece.”

rows.output: Masu goyon bayan sauya sunan, ciki har da Firayim Minista Zoran Zaev, suna jayayya cewa hakan farashi ne da ya dace a bi wajen neman shiga cikin kungiyoyi kamar EU da NATO ga Masedoniya, daya daga cikin kasashen da suka fito daga rugujewar Yugoslavia.
rows.reference: Masu goyon bayan canza sunan, da suka haɗa da Firaminista Zoran Zaev, sun yi mahawara cewa wata sadaukarwa ce don bin shiga cikin hukumomin kamar su Tarayyar Turai da NATO don Macedonia, ɗaya daga cikin ƙasashe da suka bayyana daga rushewa ta Yugoslavia.

rows.output: Na zo yau ne domin kada kuri’a ga makomar kasar, ga matasa a Masedoniya su samu rayuwa cikin ‘yanci a karkashin inuwar Tarayyar Turai domin yana nufin rayuwa mai aminci ga kowa.
rows.reference: “Na zo nan yau don jefa kuri’a don makoma ta ƙasar, don mutane samari a cikin Macedonia saboda za su iya rayuwa da ‘yanci a ƙarƙashin lema ta Tarayyar Turai saboda yana nufin rayuwa mai tsaro a gare mu,” inji Olivera Georgijevska, mai shekaru 79, a cikin Skopje.

rows.output: Duk da cewa ba a wajabta ta doka ba, amma isassun ‘yan majalisar dokoki sun bayyana cewa za su bi sakamakon kuri’ar, wanda ya sa ta zama mai muhimmanci.
rows.reference: Kodayake ba ya da ƙarfi na shari’a, isassun mambobi na majalisar dokoki sun ce za su bi sakamako na jefa kuri’ar don ta zama ta daidaita.

rows.output: Sake suna zai bukaci kashi biyu bisa uku a majalisar dokoki.
rows.reference: Canza sunan zai buƙaci wan yawa na kashi biyu bisa uku na majalisar dokokin.

rows.output: Hukumar zabe ta jihar ta ce ba a samu rahoton wani abu ba da misalin karfe 1 na rana.
rows.reference: Hukumar zaɓe ta ƙasar ta ce babu rahotanni na matsaloli har zuwa ƙarfe 1 na rana.

rows.output: Duk da haka, fitowar masu jefa kuri'a ta kasance kawai kashi 16 cikin 100, idan aka kwatanta da kashi 34 cikin 100 a zabukan majalisar dokokin da suka gabata a shekarar 2016, lokacin da kashi 66 cikin 100 na masu rajista suka kada kuri'unsu.
rows.reference: Amma, fitowar ta tsaya kawai a kashi 15 cikin ɗari, idan an kwatanta da kashi 34 a cikin ɗari a zaɓen majalisar dokoki na 2016 a yayin da kashi 66 cikin ɗari na masu jefa kuri’a da ke rijista suka kaɗa kuri’arsu.

rows.output: "Na fito na zabe saboda 'ya'yana, wurinmu yana Turai," in ji Gjose Tanevski, mai shekaru 62, wanda ya zabe a babban birnin, Skopje.
rows.reference: “Na fito ne don jefa kuri’a saboda ‘ya’yana, matsayinmu yana cikin Turai ne,” inji Gjose Tanevski, mai shekaru 62, wani mai jefa kuri’a cikin babban birnin, Skopje.

rows.output: Ndị omeiwu Welsh na-echegbu onwe ha banyere "ịdị ka muppets"
rows.reference: Welsh AM na enwe mgbakasị ahụ maka ‘ị dị ka ihe egwuregwu’

rows.output: Enwere ụjọ n'etiti ụfọdụ AMs maka aro na a ga-agbanwe aha ha ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Onye otu nzuko omeiwu Welsh).
rows.reference: Enwere nchekasị ahụ n’ime ụfọdụ AMs maka ntụle na ekwesịrị ịgbanwe aha ha ka ọ bụrụ MWPs (Member of the Welsh Parliament).

rows.output: Ọ na-eme n'ihi atụmatụ ịgbanwe aha nzuko ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Ụlọ Nzukọ Welsh.
rows.reference: Ọ malitere n’ihi atụmatụ nke ịgbanwe aha nke ndị otu obodo ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Nzụkọ Omeiwu Welsh.

rows.output: Ndị AM n'ofe ọdịnaya ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na-echegbu onwe ha na ọ nwere ike ịkpata ihere.
rows.reference: AMs n’ofe ụdị ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị dị iche iche na enwe nchekasị ahụ na ọ nwere ike ibute ihe mkparị.

rows.output: Otu onye Labour AM kwuru na otu ya nwere nchegbu "na ọ na-ada ụda dị ka Twp na Pwp."
rows.reference: Otu AM nke Labour kwuru na ndị otu ya na echekasị na “ọ na ada ka Twp na Pwp.”

rows.output: Maka ndị na-agụ n'èzí Wales: N'asụsụ Welsh, twp pụtara onye ara ara na pwp pụtara ihe mkpofu.
rows.reference: Maka ndị ọgụ akwụkwọ nọ na mpụga Wales: Na Welsh twp pụtara iberibe, pwp pụtara nsị.

rows.output: Otu Plaid AM kwuru na otu ahụ dum "adịghị enwe obi ụtọ" ma tụpụta ihe ndị ọzọ.
rows.reference: AM Yi Uwe Ajị Anụ kwuru na otu ahụ dị ka dum “na ewe iwe”, na ọ nwere ihe ndị ọzọ atụnyere.

rows.output: Otu onye Conservative Welsh kwuru na òtù ya "na-emeghe uche" banyere mgbanwe aha ahụ, ma kwuo na ọ bụ obere ịgafe okwu site na MWP ruo Muppet.
rows.reference: Otu onye Kọnzavetiv Welsh kwuru na otu ya “meghere obi emeghe” gbasara mgbanwe aha ahụ, mana kwupụta na ọ bụ mkpumkpu nwụfe okwu site na MWP gaa na Ihe Egwuregwu.

rows.output: N'ọnọdụ a, mkpụrụedemede Welsh w na-ekwu dị ka ụda nke mkpụrụedemede u na asụsụ Bekee Yorkshire.
rows.reference: Na nghọta a ana akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede w nke Welsh otu ụzọ ka esi akpọpụta mkpụrụedemede u nke Bekee nke Yorkshire.

rows.output: Kọmitii na-ahụ maka ọgbakọ, nke na-ede ugbu a iwu iji webata mgbanwe aha, kwuru: "Mkpebi ikpeazụ na nkọwa ọ bụla nke ihe ndị otu na-akpọ ga-adị n'aka ndị otu n'onwe ha."
rows.reference: Kọmishọn nke Mgbakọ Mba ahụ, nke na edepụta iwu iji bubata mgbanwe aha ahụ, kwuru: “Mkpebi ikpeazụ na ihe nkọwa ọ bụla nke a na akpọ Ndị Otu nke Mgbakọ Mba ga-abụ okwu maka ndị otu n’onwe ha.”

rows.output: Iwu Ọchịchị Wales 2017 nyere ndị ọchịchị Welsh ikike ịgbanwe aha ya.
rows.reference: Gọọmentị nke Atụmatụ Wales 2017 nyere mgbakọ mba Welsh ikike iji gbanwee aha ya.

rows.output: N'ọnwa Juun, kọmiti ahụ wepụtara nsonaazụ nke a na-akpọ ọha na eze gbasara atụmatụ ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado sara mbara maka ịkpọ ọgbakọ ahụ dị ka Ụlọ omeiwu Welsh.
rows.reference: Na Juun, Kọmịshọn ahụ bipụtara nsonaazụ nke ndụmọdụ ọhaneze na ebumnuche ndị ahụ nke chọpụtara nkwado gbasara agbasa maka ịkpọ mgbakọ mba ahụ Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh.

rows.output: N'ihe gbasara aha AMs, kọmishọna ahụ kwadoro ndị omebe iwu Welsh Parliament ma ọ bụ WMPs, mana nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kacha n'oge nzukọ ọha.
rows.reference: N’okwu nke aha nke ndị AM, Kọmịshọn ahụ dabedoro na Ndị Otu Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Welsh ma ọ bụ WMP, mana nhọrọ MWP nwetara nkwado kachasị n’aka ndụmọdụ nke ọhaneze.

rows.output: Ndị AM na-egosi na ha na-atụ aro nhọrọ ndị ọzọ, mana ọgụ iji nweta nkwekọrịta nwere ike ịbụ isi ọwụwa maka Onye isi oche na-ahụ maka Elin Jones, onye a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-ebuga ụdị iwu na mgbanwe n'ime izu ole na ole.
rows.reference: Ndị AM na atụnye nhọrọ ndị ọzọ n’ezie, mana ọgụ iji ruo nkwekọrịta nwere ike ịbụ ihe isi mgbu maka Onye Ọrụ Nọ N’isi, Elin Jones, onye nke atụrụ anya na ọ ga-enyefe iwu edere edere maka mgbanwe ndị ahụ n’ime izu ndị na abịa.

rows.output: Iwu gbasara mgbanwe ahụ ga-agụnye mgbanwe ndị ọzọ na otú òtù ahụ si arụ ọrụ, gụnyere iwu gbasara ịkagbu ndị AM na nhazi nke usoro kọmitii.
rows.reference: Iwu maka mmezi ndị ahụ ga-agụnye mgbanwe ndị ọzọ n’ụzọ nke mgbakọ mba ahụ si arụ ọrụ, gụnyere iwu maka nchutu nke ndị AM yana nka nke sistemụ otu ahụ.

rows.output: Ndị AM ga-enweta votu ikpeazụ na ajụjụ nke ihe ha kwesịrị ịkpọ mgbe ha na-akparịta ụka n'iwu ahụ.
rows.reference: Ndị AM ga-enwete ntuli aka ikpeazụ gbasara ajụjụ nke ihe ekwesịrị ịkpọ ha mgbe ha arụtụrụ aka gbasara iwu ahụ.

rows.output: Ndị Macedonians na-aga n'ịtụ vootu na ntuli aka gbasara ịgbanwe aha obodo ahụ
rows.reference: Ndị Macedonia ga-aga ntuli aka maka nhọpụta nke ịgbanwe aha obodo ha

rows.output: Ndị na-eme ntuli aka ga-eme ntuli aka na Sọnde ka ha kpebie ịgbanwe aha obodo ha ka ọ bụrụ "Republic of North Macedonia."
rows.reference: Ndị ntuli aka ga-atuli aka na Sọnde ma a ga-agbanwe aha obodo ha ka ọ bụrụ “Repọbliki nke North Macedonia.”

rows.output: E mere votu a ma ama iji dozie esemokwu ogologo oge na ala ndi gbara agbata obi, ndi nwere mpaghara aha Macedonia.
rows.reference: Atọlitere ntuli aka nke igwe mmadụ iji kpezie esemokwu ogologo oge dị n’etiti ndị agbataobi bụ Greece, nke nwere mpaghara nke ya akpọrọ Macedonia.

rows.output: Ndị Athens na-ekwu ogologo oge na aha onye agbata obi ha n'ebe ugwu na-anọchi anya ihe ha na-ekwu na ha nwere n'ala ha ma na-emegide ịbanye n'òtù EU na NATO ugboro ugboro.
rows.reference: Oteela Athens kwubere na aha nke ndị agbataobi ya nọ n’ugwu na egosipụta nzọrọ na mpaghara ya, ha agaala n’ihu na egbochi arịrịọ nsonye ya maka EU na NATO.

rows.output: Onye isi ala Macedonia Gjorge Ivanov, onye na-emegide ntuli aka gbasara mgbanwe aha, ekwuola na ya ga-echefu votu ahụ.
rows.reference: Onye Isi Ala Gjorge Ivanov nke Macedonia, onye iro nke ntuli aka na mgbanwe aha ahụ, ekwuola na ọ ga-eleghara ntuli aka ahụ anya.

rows.output: Ọbụna ndị na-akwado ntuli aka ahụ, gụnyere onye isi ala Zoran Zaev, na-arụ ụka na mgbanwe aha bụ naanị ego a ga-akwụ ụgwọ iji sonyere EU na NATO.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, ndị nkwado nke nhọpụta ahụ, gụnyere Praịm Minista Zoran Zaev, na arụrụ aka na mgbanwe aha ahụ bụ naanị ụgwọ a ga-akwụ iji sonye na EU na NATO.

rows.output: Mkpọmkpọ nke St. Martin na-akwụsị ịkụ aka ka ụka na Harlem na-agba mgba
rows.reference: Mgbịrịmgba nke St. Martin Dara Jụụ ka Ndị Ụlọ Ụka dị na Harlem Na Agba Mba

rows.output: "N'akụkọ ihe mere eme, ndị okenye m gwara kwuru na e nwere ụlọ mmanya na ụka n'akụkụ ọ bụla," ka Maazị Adams kwuru.
rows.reference: “N’akụkọ ochie, ndị okenye m gwara okwu kwuru na enwere ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ ụka n’akụkụ niile,” Maazị Adams kwuru.

rows.output: "Ụbọchị a, enweghị ihe ọ bụla."
rows.reference: “Taa, enweghị nke ọ bụla.”

rows.output: O kwuru na ịkụda mmanya na-aba n'anya bụ ihe a na-aghọta.
rows.reference: O kwuru na aghọtara ọpụpụ nke ụlọ mmanya ndị ahụ.

rows.output: "Ndị mmadụ na-akpakọrịta n'ụzọ dị iche" ugbu a, o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ndị mmadụ na emerịkọta n’ụzọ dị iche iche” ugbu a, o kwuru.

rows.output: "Ụlọ mmanya anọghịzi na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ụlọ obibi obodo ebe ndị mmadụ na-aga kwa ụbọchị."
rows.reference: “Ụlọ mmanya abụghịzị ime ụlọ nke gburugburu ebe ndị mmadụ na-aga kwa oge.”

rows.output: N'ihe gbasara ụka, ọ na-echegbu onwe ya na ego sitere na ire ere ihe onwunwe agaghị adịru ogologo oge ka ndị ndú na-atụ anya, "ma n'oge na-adịghị anya, ha ga-alọghachi ebe ha malitere."
rows.reference: Maka ndị ụlọ ụka, ọ na echekasị na ego enwetere na ịre akụ agaghị anọte aka otu ndị isi si chee, “ma n’oge adịghị anya ma ọ bụ emechaa ha ga-alaghachite ebe ha bidoro.”

rows.output: N'ikwu ya n'asụsụ Igbo, ọ bụrụ na e nwere ụlọ ụka, a pụrụ iji ụlọ elu dochie ha, nke nwere ụlọ obibi nke jupụtara na ndị ga-enyere aka n'ịkwado ebe nsọ ndị fọdụrụ n'ime obodo ahụ.
rows.reference: Ndị ụlọ ụka, o tinyere, na enwere ike iji nnukwu ụlọ obibi nwere dochie ha, nke eji ụdị ndị mmadụ na agaghị enyere aka n’ebe nsọ nke gburugburu ahụ fọdụrụ.

rows.output: "N'ime ndị na-azụ ụlọ nkwari akụ n'ime ụlọ ndị a, ọtụtụ n'ime ha ga-abụ ndị ọcha, nke ga-eme ka ụbọchị ndị ụka a na-emechi kpamkpam. Nke a bụ n'ihi na ọ gaghị adị mma ka ọtụtụ n'ime ndị na-akwaga n'ime ụlọ ndị a ghọọ ndị otu ụka a."
rows.reference: “Nnukwu imirikiti ndị mmadụ na azụta nkewa ụlọ n’ụlọ ndị a ga-abụ ndị ọcha, “o kwuru, “ya mere ha ga-eme ka ụbọchị nke ndị ụlọ ụka a ga-emechi kpamkpam bịa ngwangwa n’ihi ọ ga-esi ike imirikiti ndị mmadụ na akwabata n’ime ụlọ ndị a bụrụ ndị otu nke ụlọ ụka ndị a.”

rows.output: Ndị ụka abụọ a wuru site n'aka ndị obodo ọcha tupu Harlem ghọọ obodo ojii - Ụka Obodo na 1870, St. Martin's afọ iri ka e mesịrị.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ụka abụọ ahụ bụ ndị mgbakọ ndị ọcha rụrụ ha tupu Harlem abụrụ obodo ndị isi ojii - Ogbe Obodo Ukwuu na 1870, St. Martin bụ afọ iri ka emechara.

rows.output: Ndị ụka ọcha Methodist mbụ kwagara n'afọ 1930.
rows.reference: Ọgbakọ ndị Methodist nke izizi pụrụ na 1930.

rows.output: Otu ọgbakọ ojii nke na-efe ofufe nso nso a nwetara ihe onwunwe nke ụlọ ahụ.
rows.reference: Ọgbakọ ndị isii ojii nọ na efe ofufe n’akụkụ wegara aha n’ụlọ ahụ.

rows.output: N'ime ọgbakọ ojii n'okpuru Rev. John Howard Johnson, bụ onye duziri ịkụda ụlọ ahịa na 125th Street, okporo ámá bụ isi maka ịzụ ahịa na Harlem, bụ ndị na-eguzogide ịrụ ọrụ ma ọ bụ ịkwalite ndị ojii.
rows.reference: Ndị ọgbakọ isi ojii weghara St. Martin n’okpuru Rev. John Howard Johnson, onye duru mgbochi nke ndị mgbere ahịa dị na Okporo Ụzọ 125, isi okporo ụzọ maka ịzụ ahịa dị na Harlem, ndị gbochiri ịwere ma ọ bụ ịkwado ndị isi ojii n’ahịa.

rows.output: Mgbọ na 1939 bibiri ụlọ ahụ nke ukwuu, ma ka ndị ụka nke Nna Johnson na-eme atụmatụ ịrụzi ya, ha nyere iwu ka a na-akpọ ọkụ.
rows.reference: Ọkụ gbara na 1939 mebiri ụlọ ahụ nnukwu, mana ka ndị ụka nke Fada Johnson haziri ịrụgharị ụlọ ahụ, ha rụrụ igwe mgbịrịmgba ahụ.

rows.output: Onye ụkọchukwu David Johnson, nwa nwoke Ọkpara Johnson na onye nọchiri ya na St. Martin's, kpọrọ oku ọkụ "ìhè ndị ogbenye."
rows.reference: Rev. David Johnson, nwa Fada Johnson yana onye nọchiri na St. Martin, ji obi aṅụrị kpọọ igwe mgbịrịmgba ahụ “mgbịrịmgba nke ndị ogbenye.”

rows.output: Onye ọkachamara nke na-egwu ụgbọ ala n’ọnwa Julaị kpọrọ ya ihe ọzọ: “ihe nketa omenala” na “ngwa ọrụ akụkọ ihe mere eme na-adịghị eme ihe ọzọ.”
rows.reference: Ọkachamara onye kụrụ igwe mgbịrịmgba ahụ na Julaị kpọrọ ya ihe ọzọ: “Akụ omenala” yana “akụrụngwa akụkọ ihe mere eme enweghị ike idochi.”

rows.output: Onye ọkachamara, Tiffany Ng nke Mahadum Michigan, kwukwara na ọ bụ ụgbọ okporo ígwè mbụ n'ụwa ndị na-egwu egwu nke onye na-egwu egwu ojii, Dionisio A. Lind, onye kwagara n'ụgbọ okporo ígwè buru ibu nke Ụka Riverside afọ iri na asatọ gara aga.
rows.reference: Ọkachamara ahụ, Tiffany Ng nke Mahadum nke Michigan, kwukwara na ọ bụ igwe mgbịrịmgba izizi dị n’ụwa nke onye egwu isi ojii ga-akpọ, Dionisio A. Lind, onye nke gara n’igwe mgbịrịmgba ka ibu dị na Ụlọ Ụka Riverside afọ 18 gara aga.

rows.output: Ọkachamara Merriweather kwuru na St. Martin emeghị ka ọ dochie ya.
rows.reference: Maazị Merriweather kwuru na St. Martin anọchighi ya.

rows.output: Ihe na-eme na St. Martin n’ime ọnwa ole na ole gara aga bụ akụkọ mgbagwoju anya nke ndị na-ese ụkpụrụ ụlọ na ndị na-ewu ụlọ, ụfọdụ ndị e wetara n’aka ndị ndú ụka, ndị ọzọ n’aka ndị ụkọchukwu Diocese.
rows.reference: Ihe akpọrọ na St. Martin n’ofe ọnwa ole ma ole gara aga bụ akụkọ nke ndị ọsịse na ndị nrụpụta gbagwojuru anya, ụfọdụ nke ndị ndu nke ụlọ ụka ahụ webatara, ndị ọzọ bụ nke ngalaba ụka dị n’okpuru ọchịchị ndị Bishọpụ.

rows.output: N'ime ụlọ ụka - ọchịchị obodo, nke e ji ndị isi obodo mejupụta - dere bishọp n'ọnwa Julaị na nchegbu na bishọp "ga-achọ ịnyefe ụgwọ" n'ime ụlọ ụka, n'agbanyeghị na ụlọ ụka ahụ emetụtaghị aka n'ịhọrọ ndị na-ese ụkpụrụ ụlọ na ndị na-arụ ọrụ bishọp zitere.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ọzụzụ - otu nchịkwa nke ụlọ ụka ahụ, nke ndị ndu juputara - degara ngalaba ụka ahụ na Julaị maka echiche na ngalaba ụka ahụ “ga-achọ ịnyefe ụgwọ ndị ahụ” n’aka ụlọ ozuzu ahụ, ọbụlagodi na ụlọ ozuzu ahụ etinyeghị aka na iwere ndi ọsịse na ndị nrụpụta na ngalaba ụka ahụ ezitere.

rows.output: Ndị ụka ụfọdụ kwuputara enweghị nghọta n'aka diocese.
rows.reference: Ụfọdụ ndị ụka kpesara ụkọ nke mkpughe na ngalaba ụka ahụ.

rows.output: Otu shark merụrụ nwa agbọghọ dị afọ 13 ahụ n'oge ịkụ azụ lobster na California
rows.reference: Shark merụrụ nwa afọ 13 ahụ na mmanye lọbsta dị na California

rows.output: N'ime Satọde, e nwere ọdụm wakporo ma merụọ nwa okorobịa dị afọ 13 ahụ mgbe ọ na-egwu mmiri maka ọdụm na California n'ụbọchị mmalite nke oge ịkụ ọdụm.
rows.reference: Shark makpuru ma merụọ nwa nwoke afọ 13 ahụ na Satọde ka ọ na amanye na mmiri maka lọbsta na California n’ụbọchị mmepe nke oge lọbsta, ndị ikike kwuru.

rows.output: Mwakpo ahụ mere n'elekere 7 nke ụtụtụ nso n'Ụsọ Oké Osimiri Beacon na Encinitas.
rows.reference: Mmakpu ahụ mere tupu 7 ụtụtụ n’akụkụ Osimiri nke Beacon na Encinitas.

rows.output: Mgbe ọkara awa nke ịkụ azụ n'ụtụtụ Satọde, Chad Hammel nụrụ ka nwa okorobịa na-eti mkpu maka enyemaka. O wee gaa n'ụgbọ mmiri ya na ndị enyi ya, ha wee nyere aka ịdọpụ ya n'ime mmiri.
rows.reference: Chad Hammel gwara KSWB-TV na San Diego na ya na ndị enyi nọ na amanye na mmiri ihe dị ka ọkara aka elekere n’ụtụtụ Satọde mgbe ọ nụrụ ka nwa nwoke ahụ na eti mkpu enyemaka, mgbe ahụ ya na ụfọdụ kworo ụgbọ gafee iji nyere aka dọpụta ya n’ime mmiri.

rows.output: Hammel kwuru na mbụ na o chere na ọ bụ ihe ọṅụ nke ijide ọdụm, ma o mesịa “mara na ọ na-eti mkpu, ‘E bibiri m!’
rows.reference: Hammel kwuru n’izizi na ọ chere na ọ bụ ihe ọhụụ nke ijide lọbsta, mana mgbe ahụ ọ “chọpụtara na ọ na eti, “atara m!

rows.output: M gara n'agbụ!
rows.reference: Atara m!'

rows.output: Mkpịsị aka ya niile gbawara agbawa," Hammel kwuru na ọ hụrụ mgbe ọ rutere nwa okorobịa ahụ.
rows.reference: Adọpuru ọkpụkpụ ụkwụ ya niile, “ Hammel kwuru na ọ chọpụtara ozugbo o rutere nwa nwoke ahụ.

rows.output: "Ekpere m n'èzí onye ọ bụla ka ọ pụọ n'ime mmiri: 'Enwere agụ n'ime mmiri!'" Hammel gbakwụnyere.
rows.reference: “Etiri m mkpu ka mmadụ niile pụta na mmiri ahụ: ‘Enwere shark n’ime mmiri ahụ!”” Hammel tinyere.

rows.output: Ebuliri nwa okorobịa ahụ gaa n'ụlọ ọgwụ ụmụaka Rady dị na San Diego ebe a na-ekwu na ọ nọ n'ọnọdụ dị oke egwu.
rows.reference: Eji ụgbọ elu buru nwa nwoke ahụ gaa Ụlọ Ọgwụ Ụmụaka Rady dị na San Diego ebe edebanyere ya n’ọnọdụ ihe egwu.

rows.output: Ụdị shark nke kpatara mwakpo ahụ amabeghị.
rows.reference: Amaghị ụdị nke shark mere mmakpu ahụ.

rows.output: Onye nlekọta ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri Capt. Larry Giles kwuru na nnọkọ mgbasa ozi na e hụrụ shark n'ógbè ahụ izu ole na ole gara aga, ma chọpụta na ọ bụghị ụdị shark dị ize ndụ.
rows.reference: Lifeguard Capt. Larry Giles kwuru na nchịkọta akụkọ na ahụrụ shark na mpaghara ahụ n’izu ole ma ole gara aga, mana ekpebiri na ọ bụghị ụdị shark jọrọ njọ.

rows.output: Giles gbakwunyere na onye ahụ merụrụ ahụ n'ahụ́ mgbu n'akụkụ elu.
rows.reference: Giles tinyere na onye ahụ ihe mere nwere mmerụ ahụ buru ibu n’akụkụ elu ahụ ya.

rows.output: Ndị ọrụ mechiri ụzọ ịbanye n'oké osimiri site na Ponto Beach na Casablanca ruo Swami's na Encinitas maka awa 48 maka nyocha na ebumnuche nchekwa.
rows.reference: Ndị ikike mechiri osimiri ahụ bido na Akụkụ Osimiri Ponto dị na Casablad ruo Swami dị na Ecinitas n’ime aka elekere 48 maka ebumnuche nnyocha na nchedo.

rows.output: Giles kwuru na e nwere ihe karịrị 135 ụdị shark n'ógbè ahụ, mana ọtụtụ n'ime ha anaghị ewere dị ize ndụ.
rows.reference: Giles kwukwara na enwere karịa ụdị shark 135 dị na mpaghara ahụ, mana anaghị ahụta imirikiti ka ndị jọrọ njọ.

rows.output: Atụmatụ Sainsbury na-aga n'ihu n'ahịa ịma mma UK
rows.reference: Atụmatụ nke Sainbury ịbanye n’ahịa ihe ịchọ mma nke UK

rows.output: Sainsbury's na-eweghachi ọgụ, Boots, Superdrug na Debenhams na ụlọ ahịa ụlọ ahịa ụdị ịma mma nke ndị ọrụ pụrụ iche na-elekọta.
rows.reference: Sainbury na eche Boots, Superdrug na Debenhams aka mgba site na iji warawara ụzọ ịchọ mma nwere nka-ụlọ ahịa eji ndị enyemaka ọkachamara kpojuo.

rows.output: Dị ka akụkụ nke nnukwu ịbanye na ahịa ịma mma UK £2.8bn, nke na-aga n'ihu na-eto eto mgbe ahịa ejiji na homeware dara azụ, ụlọ ahịa ndị buru ibu ga-eme nyocha na ụlọ ahịa iri na otu n'ofe mba ahụ, ma gbasaa na ụlọ ahịa ndị ọzọ n'afọ na-esote ma ọ bụrụ na ọ na-aga nke ọma.
rows.reference: Dị akụkụ nke ọkpụrụkpụ mbanye n’ime ahịa ihe ịchọ mma £2.8n nke UK, nke na aga n’ihu etolite ebe ahịa uwe na ngwa ụlọ na alaghachi, a ga-anwale warawara ụzọ ịchọ mma n’ime ụlọ ahịa 11 na gburugburu obodo ahụ ma buga ya n’ụlọ ahịa ndị ọzọ n’afọ na esote ma ọ bụrụ na ọ gaa nke ọma.

rows.output: Itinye ego n'ime ịma mma na-abịa n'ihi na nnukwu ụlọ ahịa na-achọ ụzọ isi jiri oghere shelf ndị e ji akwụ ụgwọ maka TV, microwave, na ihe ịchọ mma.
rows.reference: Nkwanye ego n’ihe ịchọ mma na abịa ka ụlọ ahịa na achụ ụzọ iji mejuo oghere nke edobeburu maka Igwe onyonyoo, mikrowevụ na ngwa ụlọ.

rows.output: Sainsbury kwuru na ọ ga-agbakwunye ụdị ọmarịcha ya okpukpu abụọ ruo 3,000, gụnyere ika dị ka Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman na Dr. PawPaw maka oge mbụ.
rows.reference: Sainsbury kwuru na ọ ga-abasa nha nke ngwaahịa ihe ịchọ mma ya ruo ngwaahịa 3,000, gụnyere ụlọ ọrụ dị ka Revlon, Essie, Tweezerman na Dr. PawPaw nke izizi.

rows.output: Ụdị dị ugbu a sitere na L'Oreal, Maybelline naurt's Bees ga-enwekwu oghere na mpaghara ndị a na-akpọ aha dị ka ndị a na-ahụ na ụlọ ahịa dị ka Boots.
rows.reference: Oke ndị dị adị malite na L'Oreal, Maybelline na Burt’s Bees ga-enwetakwa oghere na mpaghara nwere akara yitere ndị ahụ ahụrụ n’ụlọ ahịa dị ka Boots.

rows.output: Ahịa ahịa ahụ na-eweghachikwa ụdị ejiji ya, ka ọtụtụ n'ime ngwaahịa ahụ wee bụrụ ndị na-eri anụ - ihe a na-achọkarị nke ukwuu site n'aka ndị na-azụ ahịa na-eto eto.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ahịa ndị ahụ na amalitegharị ahịa ihe ịchọ mma Ụlọ Ahịa ya ka imirikiti ngwaahịa ahụ bụrụ nke na emejọghị ụmụ anụmanụ - ihe ndị ahịa na etolite na achọ nnukwu ugbu a.

rows.output: N'ikpeazụ, onye na-ere isi ísì, The Fragrance Shop, ga-eme nyocha na ụlọ ahịa Sainsbury, nke mbụ nke mepere emepe na Croydon, London ndịda, n'izu gara aga, ebe nke abụọ ga-emeghe na Selly Oak, Birmingham, n'oge ọzọ n'afọ a.
rows.reference: Na mgbakwunye, ndị mgbere isi ụtọ Fragrance Shop ga-anwale ikikere n’ụlọ ahịa Sainsbury abụọ, nke izizi emepere na Croydon, ndịda London, izu gara aga ebe nke abụọ ga-emepe na Selly Oak, Birmingham, emechaa n’afọ a.

rows.output: Ịzụ ahịa n'ịntanetị na mgbanwe n'ịzụ obere nri kwa ụbọchị n'ụlọ ahịa dị n'ógbè ahụ na-eme ka ndị ahịa nwee ike ịdọrọ ndị mmadụ ka ha gaa.
rows.reference: Ịzụ ahịa n’ịntanetị na mbugharị gaa na ịzụ obere nri kwa ụbọchị na ntakịrị ụlọ ahịa dị na mpaghara pụtara na ndị nnukwu ụlọ ahịa na enwekwu ọrụ ịrụ iji mee ka ndị mmadụ bịa.

rows.output: Onye isi ụlọ ọrụ Sainsbury, Mike Coupe, ekwuola na ụlọ ahịa ndị ahụ ga-adị ka ụlọ ahịa n'ọdịnihu ka ụlọ ọrụ ahụ na-agbalị ịlụ ọgụ megide ndị na-ere ahịa dị ọnụ ala, Aldi na Lidl, site n'inye ọtụtụ ọrụ na ihe ndị na-abụghị nri.
rows.reference: Mike Coupe, onye isi oche nke Sainsbury, ekwuola na obere ụlọ ahịa ga-aga n’ihu n adịkwa ka nnukwu ụlọ ahịa nke ụlọ ahịa ebe ngalaba nnukwu ụlọ ahịa na anwa ịchụghachi ndị mwepu ego Aldi na Lidl site na ijikwu ọrụ na ihe ndị abụghị nri.

rows.output: Sainsbury's etinyela ụlọ ahịa Argos n'ime ụlọ ahịa narị na iri na abụọ ma webata ọtụtụ ụlọ ahịa Habitat kemgbe ọ zụtara ụlọ ọrụ abụọ ahụ afọ abụọ gara aga. Ha na-ekwu na nke a emeela ka ahịa nri na-ere ahịa dịkwuo mma ma mee ka ịzụrụ ihe dịkwuo elu.
rows.reference: Sainsbury na etinye obere ụlọ ahịa Argos n’ọtụtụ ọdụ ahịa, o bubatakwara ọnụọgụ Habitats pụtara ihie kemgbe ọ zụtara ụlọ ọrụ abụọ ndị ahụ afọ abụọ gara aga, nke o kwuru bawanyere ahịa nri ma mee ka nzụrụ ahụ mụtakwuo uru.

rows.output: "Ọnọdụ dị ize ndụ kacha atụ anya site na Rosa ma ọ bụ ihe fọdụrụ ya bụ oke mmiri ozuzo na Baja California, northwestern Sonora, na U.S. Desert Southwest," ka National Hurricane Center kwuru.

rows.output: "Nke ahụ bụ ihe mere m ji na-agba ọsọ n'ebe niile na-alụ ọgụ maka ndị na-azọ ọkwa dị mma."
rows.reference: “Ya mere m ji nọrọ n’ebe niile na akwado ndị anamachọihe mara oke mma.”

rows.output: N'ime ọdịnaya ahụ, Trump kwuru na ndị Democrats nọ n'ọrụ ịlụ ọgụ na "ịjụ oyi na igbochi."
rows.reference: Trump rụrụ aka na ndị Demokrats nọ na njem iji “kwụsị ma gbochido.”

rows.output: N'ime izu ahụ, a na-atụ anya na a ga-eme ntuli aka mbụ n'ala ụlọomeiwu gbasara nhọpụta Kavanaugh, onye enyemaka ndú GOP nke elu nke ọma kwuru na CNN.
rows.reference: Ntuli aka izizi dị mkpa n’ọkwa Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu maka nhọpụta nke Kavanaugh ka atụrụ anya ga-eme tupu Fraịde gachaa, onye otu ọchịchị GOP dị elu gwara CNN.

rows.output: Puku ndị e gburu n'ihi ọrịa ọgbụgbọ na tsunami nke Indonesia, na ọnụ ọgụgụ a na-atụ anya na ọ ga-abawanye
rows.reference: Ala ọmajiji, tsunami, nke Indonesia gburu narị kwụrụ narị ndị mmadụ, ọgụgụ ka na agbago

rows.output: N'afọ 384, ọtụtụ ndị eburula ụgbọ mmiri ka ebili mmiri buru ibu dakwasịrị n'ụsọ oké osimiri, mgbe ọdịda nke ala ọma jijiji na tsunami kụrụ agwaetiti Sulawesi nke Indonesia, ndị ọchịchị kwuru na Satọde.
rows.reference: Opekata mpe egburu ndị mmadụ 384, ka nnukwu ikuku dara n’akụkụ osimiri ekpochapụrụ ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ, mgbe nnukwu ala ọmajiji na tsunami kụrụ agwaetiti Indonesia nke Sulawesi, ndị ikikere kwuru na Satọde.

rows.output: N'ime ndị mmadụ nọ n'ìgwè dị iche iche nọ n'akụkụ osimiri n'ime obodo Palu n'ehihie Fraịde mgbe ebili mmiri dị elu nke mita isii (ụkwụ iri na asatọ) kụrụ n'ụsọ oké osimiri n'oge mgbụsị akwụkwọ, na-akpọpụ ọtụtụ mmadụ n'ime mmiri ma mebie ihe ọ bụla n'ụzọ ha.
rows.reference: Narị kwụrụ narị ndị mmadụ bịakọtara maka emume n’akụkụ osimiri n’obodo nke Palu na Fraịde mgbe ikuku ruru ogo mita isii (ụkwụ 18) dara n’ala n’oge uhuruchi, zara imirikiti banye n’ọnwụ ha ma na emebi ihe ọ bụla dị n’ụzọ ya.

rows.output: Mgbawa ahụ nwere ogo 7.5.
rows.reference: Tsunami ahụ sotere ala ọmajiji ike 7.5.

rows.output: "N'oge ihe egwu tsunami mere ụnyaahụ, ndị mmadụ ka na-eme ihe ha na osimiri ma ha ewerela ngwa ọsọ ma ghọọ ndị ihe metụtara ya," ka Sutopo Purwo Nugroho, onye na-ekwuchitere ụlọ ọrụ mgbake ọdachi nke Indonesia BNPB kwuru n'oge a na-ekwuchitere ya na Jakarta.
rows.reference: “Mgbe ihe egwu tsunami ahụ bidoro ụnyahụ, ndị mmadụ nọ na eme mmemme ha n’akụkụ osimiri ahụ, ha agbaghị ọsọ ozugbo, ya mere o ji metụta ha,” Sutopo Purwo Nugrogo, okwu okwu maka ụlọ ọrụ njikwa ọdachi mba nke Indonesia BNPS kwuru na nchịkọta na Jakarta.

rows.output: "Ọkụ mmiri ahụ abịaghị n'onwe ya, ọ na-ebu ụgbọ ala, osisi, ụlọ, ọ kụrụ ihe ọ bụla n'ala," Nugroho kwuru, na-ekwu na ọkụ mmiri ahụ agaala n'oké osimiri na ọsọ nke 800 kph (497 mph) tupu ọ kụọ n'ikpere mmiri.
rows.reference: “Tsunami ahụ abịaghị n’aka ya, o burulu ụgbọ ala, osisi, ụlọ, ọ kụrụ ihe niile nọ n’ala,” Nugroho kwuru, na ekwukwa na tsunami ahụ gafere na nnukwu osimiri n’ọsọ nke 800 kph (497 mph) tupu o daruo n’akụkụ osimiri.

rows.output: Ndị mmadụ na-akpụ akpụ n’osisi iji zere ebili mmiri ahụ ma dị ndụ, o kwuru.
rows.reference: Ụfọdụ ndị mmadụ rịrị elu osisi iji gbanarị tsunami ahụ ma dị ndụ, o kwuru.

rows.output: N'ihe dị ka mmadụ 16,700 ka a chụpụrụ gaa n'ụlọ ọrụ 24 dị na Palu.
rows.reference: Ebugara ihe ruru ndị mmadụ 16,700 n’ama 24 dị na Palu.

rows.output: Foto ndị e si n'ikuku were gosi na ọtụtụ ụlọ na ụlọ ahịa mebiri emebi, àkwà mmiri gbawara agbawa, na a na-akpọ mgbapụta n'ime mmiri.
rows.reference: Ọsịse elu nke ụlọ ọrụ ọdachi ahụ buputere gosiri imirikiti ụlọ na ụlọ ahịa emebisiri, akwa mmiri gbagochara ma daa yana ụlọ alakụba mmiri gbara okirikiri.

rows.output: Mgbawa ndị ọzọ ka na-akụ obodo dị n'akụkụ oké osimiri n'Ụbọchị Satọde.
rows.reference: Ala ọmajiji gara n’ihu na eme n’ụsọ oke osimiri ahụ na Satọde.

rows.output: Mmetụta nke ala ọma jijiji ahụ dị na mpaghara nwere mmadụ nde 2.4.
rows.reference: Enwere mmetụta usoro nke ala ọmajiji na mpaghara nwere ndị mmadụ nde 2.4.

rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ Indonesia maka nyocha na itinye teknụzụ (BPPT) kwuru n'okwu na ike a na-ewepụta site na ọdịda ahụ nke ụbọchị Fraịde ahụ dị ihe dị ka ugboro 200 ike nke bọmbụ atomik nke e ji mee ihe na Hiroshima n'oge Agha Ụwa nke Abụọ.
rows.reference: Ụlọ Ọrụ maka Nyocha na Ntinye nke Teknụzụ nke Indonesia (BPPT) kwuru na nkwupute na ike nnukwu ọmajiji nke Fraịde buputere dị ihe dị ka ugboro 200 nke ike nke ogbunigwe atọmik atụsara na Hiroshima na Agha Ụwa nke Abụọ.

rows.output: Ọdịdị ala nke obodo ahụ, nke dị n'akụkụ ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri dị ogologo, nke dị warara, nwere ike ime ka ọdịdị nke tsunami ahụ buru ibu, ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: Ala nke obodo ahụ, nke tukwu na ngwụcha nke mpaghara osimiri toro ogologo, dị warawara, nwere ike ibuwanye nha nke tsunami ahụ, ka o kwuru.

rows.output: Nugroho kọwara mmebi ahụ dị ka "nnukwu" ma kwuo na puku ụlọ, ụlọ ọgwụ, ụlọ ahịa, na ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ agbawo.
rows.reference: Nugroho kọwara mmebi ahụ ka “ihe gbasara agbasa” ma kwuo puku kwụrụ puku nke ụlọ, ụlọ ọgwụ, ọdụ ụlọ ahịa na ụlọ nkwari dara.

rows.output: Mkpọmkpọ ebe nke ụfọdụ ndị ihe metụtara ahụ nọ n'okpuru ihe mkpofu nke ụlọ ndị dara ada, o kwuru, na-agbakwụnye na mmadụ 540 merụrụ ahụ na mmadụ 29 na-efu efu.
rows.reference: Ahụrụ ahụ nke ụfọdụ ndị mmadụ ọ metụtara n’okpuru ahịhịa nke ụlọ ndị dara, o kwuru, tinye ndị mmadụ 540 merụrụ ahụ ma 29 na efu.

rows.output: Nugroho kwuru na ọnwụ na mmebi nwere ike ịdị ukwuu n'akụkụ oké osimiri 300 km (190 kilomita) n'ebe ugwu nke Palu, mpaghara a na-akpọ Donggala, nke dị nso na ebe mgbawa ahụ.
rows.reference: Nugroho kwuru na ndị nwụrụ yana mmebi nwere ike ịkarị n’ogologo ụsọ oke osimiri ahụ 300km (maịlụ 190) n’akụkụ ugwu nke Palu, mpaghara a na akpọ Donggala, nke nọketere nso na etiti nke ọmajiji ahụ.

rows.output: Nkwurịta okwu "nwere nnukwu nsogbu na enweghị ozi ọ bụla" site na Donggala, Nugroho kwuru.
rows.reference: Nkwukọrịta enweghị ozi ọ bụla ma ncha sitere na Donggala, Nugroho kwuru.

rows.output: Enwere ihe karịrị mmadụ 300,000 bi n'ebe ahụ," otu Red Cross kwuru na nkwupụta, na-agbakwụnye na ndị ọrụ ha na ndị ọrụ ha na-aga n'ebe ndị metụtara ya.
rows.reference: Enwere karịa ndị mmadụ 300,000 bi ebe ahụ,” Red Cross kwuru na nkwupute, na etinye na ndị ọrụ ya na ndị wepụtara onwe ha na aga n’ebe ndị emetụtara.

rows.output: "Nke a bụ ọdachi, ma ọ ka nwere ike ime ka ọ ka njọ."
rows.reference: O kwuru “nke a abụrụla ihe mberede, mana ọ nwere ike ịkawanye njọ,”.

rows.output: N'ụbọchị Satọde, a na-akatọ ụlọ ọrụ ahụ nke ukwuu maka na ha emeghị ka ọ pụta ìhè na a kpagburu Palu, n'agbanyeghị na ndị ọrụ kwuru na ebili mmiri ahụ rutere n'oge a na-enye ịdọ aka ná ntị.
rows.reference: Ekwutọrọ ụlọ ọrụ ahụ nke ukwuu na Satọde maka ịhapụ ikwu na tsunami dara na Palu, agbanyeghị na ndị ọrụ kwuru na nnukwu ikuku bịara n’oge enyere ịdọ aka na ntị ahụ.

rows.output: N'ime vidiyo ndị na-amachaghị ama nke ekesara na soshal midia, otu nwoke nọ n'elu ụlọ nwere ike ịnụ ka ọ na-eti mkpu n'ụjọ na-ekwu banyere igwe ojii na-abịaru nso na ndị mmadụ nọ n'okporo ámá.
rows.reference: Na nseta ekekọrịtara n’ebe mmerịkọta ọhaneze enwere ike ịnụ ka otu nwoke nọ n’elu ụlọ na eti nnukwu mkpu na adọ aka na ntị maka tsunami na abịa nke ọ na agwa ndị mmadụ n’okporo ụzọ dị n’okpuru.

rows.output: N'ime nkeji ole na ole, mmiri na-akụ n'akụkụ osimiri, na-eburu ụlọ na ụgbọ ala.
rows.reference: N’ime nkeji ole ma ole nnukwu mmiri dara n’akụkụ osimiri ahụ, buru ụlọ na ụgbọ ala.

rows.output: Reuters enweghị ike ịkọwa ihe onyonyo ahụ ozugbo.
rows.reference: Reuters enwenwughi ike inyocha nseta ahụ.

rows.output: Mgbawa ahụ na ebili mmiri ahụ kpatara nnukwu ọdịda nke ike nke bibiri nzikọrịta ozi gburugburu Palu, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ihe ịma ndị ọchịchị aka iji hazie mbọ nnapụta.
rows.reference: Ọmajiji na tsunami ahụ butere nnukwu mmebi n’ọkụ latrik nke gbubiri nkwukọrịta n’okirikiri Palu na eme ka ndị ikikere nwee nhịahụ na ịhazi mbọ ịzọpụta ndị mmadụ.

rows.output: Ndị agha amalitela iziga ụgbọ elu na-enye enyemaka site n'obodo Jakarta na ndị ọzọ, ndị ọchịchị kwuru, mana ndị a chụpụrụ n'ọrụ ka chọrọ nri na ihe ndị ọzọ dị mkpa.
rows.reference: Ndị agha ebidola iziga ụgbọ elu eji ebu ibu bu ihe enyemaka sitere na Jakarta yana obodo ndị ọzọ, ndị ikikere kwuru, mana ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ ka chọrọ nri na akụrụngwa ndị ọzọ eji ebi ndụ ngwangwa.

rows.output: Ụgbọ elu obodo ahụ emegheela naanị maka mbọ enyemaka ma ka ga-emechi ruo Ọktoba.
rows.reference: Emepegharịala ọdụ ụgbọ elu nke obodo ahụ naanị maka mbọ ihe enyemaka, a ga-aga n’ihu mechie ya ruo Ọkt.

rows.output: Onye isi ala Joko Widodo bu n'obi ịga n'ogige mgbaba na Palu na Sọnde.
rows.reference: Onye Isi Ala Joko Widodo kwesịrị ịbịa n’ama mgbabata ọsọ ndụ ndị dị na Palu na Sọnde.

rows.output: Mgbapụta tsunami nke Indonesia agafeela 800.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụ Tsunami Indonesia Agafeela 800.

rows.output: Ọ dị njọ nke ukwuu.
rows.reference: Ọ Jọrọ Oke Njọ.

rows.output: N'oge a na-ahụ maka ọrụ nke World Vision na Donggala erutela Palu n'enweghị nsogbu, ebe ndị ọrụ na-echekwa onwe ha n'ụlọikwuu akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ nke e debere n'ogige ụlọ ọrụ ha, ha hụrụ ihe mgbagwoju anya n'ụzọ ahụ, Mazị Doseba kwuru.
rows.reference: Ebe ndị ọrụ World Vision si Donggala garuru n’obodo Palu na enweghị nsogbu, ebe ndị ọrụ ya na anara ndo n’okpuru mkpuchi tapọlin atọlitere na mpụga nke ụlọ ọrụ ha, ha gafere okirikiri nke mbibi n’ụzọ ha, Maazị Doseba kwuru.

rows.output: "O kwuru na ha hụrụ ọtụtụ ụlọ ndị e bibiri."
rows.reference: O kwuru “ha gwara m na ha hụrụ ọtụtụ ụlọ emebiri,”.

rows.output: Ọ dị njọ nke ukwuu.
rows.reference: Ọ jọrọ oke njọ.

rows.output: Ọbụna mgbe ndị otu enyemaka malitere ọrụ dị egwu nke ịmalite ịkwado ihe mgbu, ụfọdụ ndị na-akatọ na ndị ọrụ enyemaka mba ọzọ nwere nnukwu ihe ọmụma na-egbochi ịga Palu.
rows.reference: Ọbụlagodi ka ndị otu enyemaka bidoro ọrụ nhịahụ nke ibido ụkwụ nke ihe enyemaka ọdachi, ụfọdụ kpesara na a na egbochi ndị ọrụ enyemaka mba ofesi nwere nka dị mkpa na ịga na Palu.

rows.output: N'ime iwu ndị Indonesia, ego, ihe, na ndị ọrụ nwere ike ịbanye naanị ma ọ bụrụ na ebe ihe mberede ahụ dị ka mpaghara mberede mba.
rows.reference: Site n’aka ndị iwu nke Indonesia, ego, ngwa na ndị ọrụ si na mba ofesi nwere naanị ike ibido ịga ma ọ bụrụ na akpọọ ebe nke mbibi ahụ ihe ogige ọdachi mba.

rows.output: Ọ nweghịkwa.
rows.reference: Nke ahụ emebeghị.

rows.output: "Ọ ka bụ ihe mberede dị na ọkwa mpaghara," ka Aulia Arriani, onye na-ekwuchitere ọbara ọbara Indonesia kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ọ ka bụ ọdachi ọkwa ogige,” Aulia Arriani kwuru, onye okwu okwu maka Red Cross nke Indonesia.

rows.output: "Ozugbo gọọmentị kwuru, "Ọ dị mma, nke a bụ ọdachi mba," anyị nwere ike imeghe maka enyemaka mba ụwa mana ọ nweghị ọkwa ọ bụla."
rows.reference: “Ozugbo gọọmentị ahụ kwuru, “Ọ dị mma, nke a bụ ọdachi mba,” anyị nwere ike imepe maka enyemaka ofesi mana enwebeghị ọkwa ọ bụla.”

rows.output: N'abalị nke abụọ nke dara na Palu mgbe ọgbọ agha na tsunami gasịrị na Fraịde, ndị enyi na ndị ikwu nke ndị ka na-efunahụ olileanya na ha hụrụ ndị ha hụrụ n'anya n'anya.
rows.reference: Ka abalị nke abụọ dara na Palu ka ala ọmajiji na tsunami nke Fraịde mechara, ndị enyi na ezinụlọ nke ndị ka na efu jidere okwukwe na ndị ha hụrụ n’anya ga-abụ ọrụ ebube na akpalite mmụọ nke akụkụ ọjọọ nke ọdachi ekereụwa.

rows.output: N'ụbọchị Satọde, a kpọpụrụ nwa nwoke nta n'ime mmiri mmiri.
rows.reference: Na Satọde, akpapụtara otu obere nwa n’ime olulu.

rows.output: N'ụbọchị Sọnde, ndị na-azọpụta napụtara nwanyị nke a na-akpọrọ n'okpuru ihe mkpofu ruo ụbọchị abụọ na ahụ nne ya nọ n'akụkụ ya.
rows.reference: Na Sọnde, ndị mgbata ọsọ enyemaka zọpụtara otu nwanyị nke akpadoro n’okpuru ahịhịa n’ime ụbọchị abụọ, n’akụkụ ya bụ ahụ nne ya.

rows.output: Gendon Subandono bụ onye nkuzi nke otu ndị na-efe efe nke Indonesia, zụrụ ndị na-efe efe abụọ na-efunahụ n'egwuregwu Eshia, nke mechara n'ọnwa a na Indonesia.
rows.reference: Gendon Subandono, onye ndu nke ndị otu paraglaịdịn nke mba Indonesia, zụrụ mmadụ abụọ nke ndị paraglaịdas maka Egwuregwu Asia na efu, nke mechiri na mbido nke ọnwa a na Indonesia.

rows.output: Ndị ọzọ ndị e ji n'agha n'ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ Roa Roa, Maazị Mandagi gụnyere, bụ ụmụ akwụkwọ ya.
rows.reference: Ndị ọzọ nke ejidere n’okpuru Ụlọ Nkwari Akụ Roa Roa, Maazị Mandagi gụnyere, bụ ụmụ akwụkwọ.

rows.output: "Dị ka onye isi na ubi igwe na-agba, enwere m ibu mmetụta uche nke m."
rows.reference: “Dị ka onye ọkaibe n’ama paraglaidin, enwere nsogbu mmụọ nke m, o kwuru.

rows.output: Ọkà Okonkwo Gendon kwuru ihe mere mgbe a kọrọ akụkọ ọdịda nke ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ Roa Roa n'etiti obodo ndị na-efe efe, o ji nlezianya zitere ozi WhatsApp na ndị asọmpi Palu, bụ ndị na-aga ememme osimiri.
rows.reference: Maazị Gendon chetara otu, n’ime elekere ka akụkọ nke ọdịda Ụlọ Nkwari Akụ Roa Roa gbasara n’ime ogbe paraglaịdịn, o ji ọsọ zigara ndị asọmpi Palu ozi na WhatsApp, ndị na esonye n’emume akụkụ osimiri ahụ.

rows.output: Ozi ya, n'agbanyeghị nke ahụ, butere naanị otu akara akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ, kama ịbụ otu akara akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ.
rows.reference: Ozi ya, agbanyeghị, dapụtara naanị n’otu nrịbama agba ntụ, kama nrịbama agba eluigwe dị mkpị.

rows.output: "Ekwenyere m na nke ahụ pụtara na ozi ahụ ebughị ụzọ."
rows.reference: “Echere m na nke ahụ pụtara na ezigaghị ozi ndị ahụ,” ka o kwuru.

rows.output: Ndị ohi na-awụpụ $26,750 n'oge imegharị ATM na Newport on the Levee
rows.reference: Ndị oyi were $26,750 n’oge mkpojugharị ATM na Newport dị na Levee

rows.output: Ndị ohi wakporo n'ụtụtụ Fraịde, zuru $26,750 n'aka onye ọrụ Brink's na-eweghachi ATM na Newport on the Levee, dị ka nkwupụta akụkọ si kwuo na ngalaba ndị uwe ojii Newport.
rows.reference: Ndị oyi n’ụtụtụ Fraịde zuru $26,750 n’aka onye ọrụ Brink na ekpojugharị ATM dị na Newport na Levee, site na akụkọ ebuputere n’aka Ngalaba Ndị Uwe Ojii Newport.

rows.output: Onye ọkwọ ụgbọ ala ahụ na-ewepụ ego n'igwe ATM n'ogige ntụrụndụ ma na-akwadebe inye ego ọzọ, ka Det. Dennis McCarthy kwuru na ntọhapụ ahụ.

rows.reference: Ndị na akwado mgbanwe aha ahụ, gụnyere Praịm Minista Zoran Zaev, na arụrịta ụka na ọ bụ ụgwọ ekwesịrị ịkwụ iji sochie nnabata n’ewumewu ndị dị ka EU na NATO maka Macedonia, otu n’ime obodo ndị pụtara n’ọdịda nke Yugoslavia.

rows.output: "Abịara m taa ịtụ vootu maka ọdịnihu obodo ahụ, maka ndị ntorobịa na Macedonia ka ha wee nwee ike ibi ndụ n'efu n'okpuru ọkọlọtọ nke European Union n'ihi na ọ pụtara na ndụ ndụ ndị a ga-adị mma maka anyị niile," ka Olivera Georgijevska, 79, kwuru na Skopje.
rows.reference: “Abịara m taa ituli aka maka ọdịnihu nke obodo anyị, maka ndị ntorobịa nọ na Macedonia ka ha nwee ike ibi ndụ otu ha chọrọ n’okpuru nche nke European Union n’ihi ọ pụtara ndụ ka mma maka anyị niile,” nke Olivera Georgijevska kwuru, 79, na Skopje.

rows.output: N'agbanyeghị na ọ bụghị iwu n'ụzọ iwu, ndị omebe iwu zuru ezu ekwuola na ha ga-erube isi n'ihe si na votu pụta ka ọ bụrụ nke na-ekpebi.
rows.reference: Agbanyeghị ọdịghị n’okpuru iwu, ndị otu nke nzụkọ ọmeiwu zuru oke ekwuola na ha ga-asọpụrụ ndapụta nke ntuli aka ahụ iji mee ka ọ bụrụ ihe dị mkpa.

rows.output: Mgbanwe aha ahụ ga-achọ ọtụtụ abụọ n'ụzọ atọ n'ime ndị omebe iwu.
rows.reference: Mgbanwe aha ahụ ga-achọ ụzọ abụọ n’ọkara ụzọ atọ nke nzụkọ ọmeiwu dị ukwuu.

rows.output: Kọmishọna ntuli aka steeti ahụ kwuru na ọ nweghị akụkọ banyere ihe na-adịghị mma ka e nwechara elekere 1 nke ehihie.
rows.reference: Ọgbakọ ntuli aka steeti kwuru na enwebeghị mkpesa nke mpụ n’ebe 1 ehihie.

rows.output: Ọzọkwa, ntuli aka ahụ ruru naanị pasentị iri na isii, ma e jiri ya tụnyere pasentị iri atọ na anọ na ntuli aka nke ndị omeiwu nke afọ 2016 mgbe pasentị iri isii na isii nke ndị na-eme ntuli aka debanyere aha ha mere ntuli aka ha.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, mpụta dị naanị na pasentị 16, tụlee pasentị 34 na ntuli aka nzụkọ ọmeiwu gara aga na 2016 mgbe pasentị 66 nke ndị ntuli aka edebanyere n’akwụkwọ tinyere akwụkwọ ntuli aka ha.

rows.output: "Agara m na-eme ntuli aka n'ihi ụmụ m, ebe anyị nọ na Europe," Gjose Tanevski, 62, onye na-eme ntuli aka n'isi obodo, Skopje, kwuru.
rows.reference: “Apụtara m ituli aka n’ihi ụmụaka m, ọnọdụ anyị bụ na Europe,” ka Gjose Tanevski kwuru, 62, onye ntuli aka n’isi ala, Skopje.
